KISW.G5.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.reveals: The question "Matini inayoanza "Mpendwa rafiki yangu," na kuishia "Ni mimi rafiki yako" ni ya aina gani?" with "insha ya masimulizi" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.help: Look at the beginning and the end: an address and greeting mean a letter.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.feedback: Salamu na hitimisho la barua huonyesha ni barua, si insha.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.PEKEE.M.error: Picks the general name of the kind of thing (mto, nchi, mji) where the particular name (Tana, Kenya, Nairobi) is needed.

example.question: Mto ___ ni mrefu kuliko mito yote nchini Kenya.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.PEKEE.M.cause: The child knows the word is a noun but not that a proper noun is the one particular name.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.PEKEE.M.reveals: A question with a name and a general noun as options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.PEKEE.M.help: Ask "Kuna mito mingi, mto huu unaitwa nani?" Names point to one only.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.PEKEE.M.feedback: Neno hilo ni jina la jumla la kitu cha aina hiyo. Nomino ya pekee ni jina la kipekee, kama Tana au Nairobi.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.PEKEE.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.PEKEE.M.error: Takes a job or title (mwalimu, daktari, mkulima) as a proper noun because it names one person.

example.question: Mwalimu mkuu wetu anaitwa ___.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.PEKEE.M.cause: A title sounds like a name when one person holds it.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.PEKEE.M.reveals: Options with a title and a given name.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.PEKEE.M.help: Many people can be called mwalimu. A name belongs to one person.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.PEKEE.M.feedback: Mwalimu ni cheo au kazi, na watu wengi wanaweza kuwa walimu. Jina la mtu, kama Kamau, ndiyo nomino ya pekee.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.PEKEE.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.PEKEE.M.error: Picks the first word of the sentence only because it starts with a capital letter.

example.question: Mwalimu alimpa Wanjiru kitabu. Nomino ya pekee ni ipi?

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.PEKEE.M.cause: The child uses the capital letter as the only sign of a proper noun.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.PEKEE.M.reveals: A sentence that starts with a common noun and has a name in the middle.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.PEKEE.M.help: Every sentence starts with a capital. Ask which word is the name of one person or place.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.PEKEE.M.feedback: Kila sentensi huanza kwa herufi kubwa, hata kama neno la kwanza ni nomino ya kawaida. Tafuta jina la mtu au mahali.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.PEKEE.M.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.PEKEE.M.error: Writes a proper noun with a small letter in the middle of a sentence (tulienda nairobi).

example.question: Andika vizuri: Tulisafiri hadi nairobi.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.PEKEE.M.cause: The child knows the capital at the start of a sentence but not that every proper noun takes one.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.PEKEE.M.reveals: The question "Andika vizuri: Tulisafiri hadi nairobi." with "Tulisafiri hadi nairobi." among the options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.PEKEE.M.help: Circle every name of a person or place in a passage; each starts with a capital wherever it is.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.PEKEE.M.feedback: Nomino ya pekee huanza kwa herufi kubwa popote ilipo katika sentensi.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.PEKEE.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.KAWAI.error: Picks a name (Juma, Mombasa) when asked for the common noun.

example.question: Chagua nomino ya kawaida: "Juma alienda Mombasa kwa basi."

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.KAWAI.cause: The child looks for any noun and takes the first one.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.KAWAI.reveals: A sentence with names and one common noun.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.KAWAI.help: Ask which word could name many buses, not one named person or place.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.KAWAI.feedback: Juma na Mombasa ni majina ya pekee. Nomino ya kawaida ni jina la jumla la aina ya kitu au mtu, kama basi.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.KAWAI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.KAWAI.error: Picks a verb or an adjective as the common noun.

example.question: Mtoto mdogo analia. Nomino ni ipi?

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.KAWAI.cause: The child has not yet fixed what a noun is: a name of a person, place, animal or thing.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.KAWAI.reveals: Options that mix a noun, a verb and an adjective.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.KAWAI.help: Ask "Ninaweza kusema huyu ni nani au hiki ni nini?"
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.KAWAI.feedback: Neno hilo si nomino. Nomino hutaja mtu, mahali, mnyama au kitu. Kitenzi hutaja kitendo, na kivumishi huelezea nomino.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.KAWAI.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.KAWAI.error: Gives a common noun a capital letter because it is important (Tulinunua Sufuria mpya).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi imeandikwa sawa?

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.KAWAI.cause: The child capitalises words he feels are important, as on posters.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.KAWAI.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi imeandikwa sawa?" with "Mama alinunua Sufuria mpya." among the options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.KAWAI.help: Ask: is it the name of one particular thing or of the kind? A kind gets a small letter.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.KAWAI.feedback: Nomino ya kawaida huandikwa kwa herufi ndogo isipokuwa mwanzoni mwa sentensi.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.KAWAI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.KAWAI.error: Picks a pronoun (yeye, wao) as the common noun.

example.question: Ni nomino ya kawaida ipi katika: "Yeye alipika wali"?

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.KAWAI.cause: A pronoun stands in the place of a noun, so it looks like one.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.KAWAI.reveals: The question "Ni nomino ya kawaida ipi katika: "Yeye alipika wali"?" with "Yeye" among the options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.KAWAI.help: Ask whether the word names a kind of thing or points to someone named before.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.KAWAI.feedback: Yeye ni kiwakilishi; wali ni jina la aina ya chakula: nomino ya kawaida.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T1_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.KAWAI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Greets a sick person with an ordinary "Habari?" and answers "Nzuri" for him, with no word of sympathy (pole).

example.question: Unamtembelea rafiki aliyelazwa hospitalini. Unasema nini kwanza?

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: The child uses the one greeting he uses everywhere.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: The question "Unamtembelea rafiki aliyelazwa hospitalini. Unasema nini kwanza?" with "Habari yako? Nzuri sana!" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: Role-play a hospital visit; list words for the sick: pole, ugua pole, Mungu akupe nafuu.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.feedback: Mgonjwa husalimiwa kwa "Pole" na kuagwa kwa "Ugua pole".
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Says "Marahaba" as the greeting to an elder and "Shikamoo" as the reply.

example.question: Mtoto anamsalimu mzee. Mtoto anasema nini?

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: The two words are always heard together and the child does not know which side says which.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: The question "Mtoto anamsalimu mzee. Mtoto anasema nini?" with "Marahaba" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: Act it out: the younger always says Shikamoo; the elder answers Marahaba.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Uses "Lala salama" or "Usiku mwema" when leaving in the morning, or "Habari za asubuhi" at night.

example.question: Unaondoka kwa jirani saa tatu asubuhi. Unaaga vipi?

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: The farewells are memorised as a list, not tied to the time of day.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: The question "Unaondoka kwa jirani saa tatu asubuhi. Unaaga vipi?" with "Usiku mwema!" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: Put farewells on a clock face: asubuhi, mchana, jioni, usiku.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.feedback: Agano hufuata wakati: asubuhi tunasema siku njema; usiku tunasema usiku mwema.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Greets with an English or Sheng word (Hi, Sasa, Niaje) where a Kiswahili greeting is asked.

example.question: Ni salamu ipi ya Kiswahili sanifu?

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: These are the greetings of the playground and the radio.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: The question "Ni salamu ipi ya Kiswahili sanifu?" with "Niaje mzee?" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: Sort greetings into sanifu and not; use only sanifu in class role plays.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.feedback: Kwa Kiswahili sanifu tunasema Hujambo au Shikamoo.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.error: Puts words in order of length, not alphabet.

example.question: Neno gani huja kwanza kwenye kamusi?

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.cause: The child looks for the shortest or the first-looking word.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.help: Say the alphabet and look at the first letter.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.feedback: Kamusi hupanga maneno kwa herufi za alfabeti, si kwa urefu wa neno.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.error: Looks only at the first letter and picks any word with the same first letter.

example.question: Neno gani huja kwanza kwenye kamusi?

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.cause: The child stops at the first letter when two words begin the same.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.reveals: Words that begin with the same letter.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.help: When the first letters match, look at the second letter.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.feedback: Maneno yanapoanza kwa herufi moja, tazama herufi ya pili, kisha ya tatu: sahani huja kabla ya samaki.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.error: Puts the end of the alphabet first.

example.question: Neno gani huja mwisho kwenye kamusi?

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.cause: The child mixes first and last.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.reveals: A question that asks for the last word.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.help: A comes first and Z comes last.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.feedback: Alfabeti huanza na A na kuishia na Z. Neno la mwisho kwenye kamusi huanza na herufi ya mwisho zaidi.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.error: Looks up a word in the form it has in the passage (alikimbia) and does not find it, instead of its root (-kimbia / kimbia).

example.question: Unataka maana ya "wanaosoma". Utatafuta neno lipi kamusini?

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.cause: The child looks for exactly what is on the page.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.reveals: The question "Unataka maana ya "wanaosoma". Utatafuta neno lipi kamusini?" with "wanaosoma" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.help: Strip the prefixes and suffixes: wa-na-o-som-a -> soma; then look up.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.feedback: Kamusi huorodhesha mzizi wa kitenzi: tafuta "soma".
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Writes facts or an explanation where a story of events is asked.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni mwanzo wa insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Siku Nilipomsaidia Majeruhi"?
example.wrong_answer: Huduma ya kwanza ni msaada unaotolewa kabla ya daktari kufika.
example.correct_answer: Nilimwona mvulana ameanguka kutoka kwenye baiskeli.

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: The child knows a lot about the topic and writes what he knows instead of telling what happened.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ni mwanzo wa insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Siku Nilipomsaidia Majeruhi"?" with "Huduma ya kwanza ni msaada unaotolewa kabla ya daktari kufika." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Ask: who, where, what happened first, then, in the end? A story answers these; an explanation does not.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Masimulizi husimulia matukio yaliyotokea: nani, wapi, nini kilitokea.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Tells a past story in the present tense (-na-), or mixes -na- and -li- in one story.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika masimulizi ya jambo lililotokea jana: "Siku Nilipomsaidia Majeruhi"?
example.wrong_answer: Ninamwona mvulana ameanguka kutoka kwenye baiskeli.
example.correct_answer: Nilimwona mvulana ameanguka kutoka kwenye baiskeli.

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: The child writes as he speaks while remembering, and English stories in class are told in the present too.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika masimulizi ya jambo lililotokea jana: "Siku Nilipomsaidia Majeruhi"?" with "Ninamwona mvulana ameanguka kutoka kwenye baiskeli." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Circle every verb; check its tense marker against the time words (jana, siku moja).
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Jambo lililotokea husimuliwa kwa wakati uliopita: -li-.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Puts the events in an order that cannot have happened (the end before the start), with no linking words.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Siku Nilipomsaidia Majeruhi"?
example.wrong_answer: nilimwita mwalimu, nilisafisha jeraha, nilimsaidia kuketi, niliona ajali
example.correct_answer: niliona ajali, nilimsaidia kuketi, nilisafisha jeraha, nilimwita mwalimu

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: The child writes events as they come to mind; nobody has asked for a plan first.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Siku Nilipomsaidia Majeruhi"?" with "nilimwita mwalimu, nilisafisha jeraha, nilimsaidia kuketi, niliona ajali" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Plan with three boxes (mwanzo, kati, mwisho) and linking words (kwanza, kisha, hatimaye) before writing.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Panga matukio yanavyofuatana, na utumie maneno kama kwanza, kisha na hatimaye.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Ends the insha abruptly ("Mwisho." or "The end") with no closing paragraph (hitimisho).

example.question: Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Siku Nilipomsaidia Majeruhi"?
example.correct_answer: Tangu siku hiyo, nimejifunza kuwa mwangalifu kila wakati.

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: Storybooks for young readers end with "Mwisho" and the child copies that.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Siku Nilipomsaidia Majeruhi"?" with "Mwisho." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Show three endings; the child picks the one that closes the main idea or the lesson.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Hitimisho hufunga insha kwa kueleza funzo au hisia, si kwa neno "Mwisho" tu.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Puts English or Sheng words in the insha (tulienda kwa party, mathe, form).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi imeandikwa kwa Kiswahili sanifu?

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: The child speaks a mixed language at home and with friends and does not notice the switch in writing.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi imeandikwa kwa Kiswahili sanifu?" with "Mathe alinipea form ya kujaza." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Underline each non-Kiswahili word; find the Kiswahili word together (mama, sherehe, fomu).
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Insha huandikwa kwa Kiswahili sanifu, bila maneno ya Kiingereza wala Sheng.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T2_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.WINGI.M.error: Leaves the noun unchanged where the plural changes it (kitabu for vitabu).

example.question: Kitabu kimoja, vitabu viwili. Andika wingi wa "kitabu".

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.WINGI.M.cause: In English most plural markers come at the end; here the prefix changes.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.WINGI.M.reveals: A plural gap where the singular is an option.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.WINGI.M.help: Ask which part of the word shows "many".
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.WINGI.M.feedback: Wingi wa nomino nyingi hubadilisha mwanzo wa neno, si mwisho. Kitabu kimoja, vitabu viwili.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.WINGI.M.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.WINGI.M.error: Puts the wrong plural prefix on the noun (watabu for vitabu, vitoto for watoto).

example.question: Wingi wa "mtoto" ni ___.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.WINGI.M.cause: The child learned one prefix and uses it for every noun.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.WINGI.M.reveals: Plurals from two classes in one question.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.WINGI.M.help: Ask "Mtoto ni mtu au kitu?" People take wa-, things like kitabu take vi-.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.WINGI.M.feedback: Kiambishi cha wingi hutegemea ngeli ya nomino. Watu hupewa wa- (watoto), na vitu kama kitabu hupewa vi- (vitabu).
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.WINGI.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.WINGI.M.error: Adds a plural prefix to a plural form or doubles it (wawatoto, vivitabu).

example.question: Wingi wa "mti" ni ___.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.WINGI.M.cause: The child tries to be sure it is plural and adds the prefix twice.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.WINGI.M.reveals: A gap where a doubled form is an option.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.WINGI.M.help: Say the word aloud and ask if one prefix is not enough.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.WINGI.M.feedback: Nomino ina kiambishi kimoja cha wingi tu. Mti mmoja, miti miwili.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.WINGI.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.WINGI.M.error: Treats a noun of wingi (maji, mafuta, maziwa) as countable and gives it a singular (jimaji, mamaji, maji moja).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni sahihi?

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.WINGI.M.cause: Most nouns the child meets have a singular and a plural, so he looks for one here too.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.WINGI.M.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ni sahihi?" with "Nimekunywa maji mawili." among the options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.WINGI.M.help: Pour water: you cannot count "one water"; you count glasses of it (glasi mbili za maji).
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.WINGI.M.feedback: Nomino za wingi kama maji hazihesabiki: maji mengi, glasi mbili za maji.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.WINGI.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.VITEN.error: Uses the bare verb stem (soma, cheza) where the verbal noun with ku- is needed.

example.question: ___ kunafurahisha.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.VITEN.cause: The child reads the stem as the noun.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.VITEN.reveals: A gap with the stem and the ku- form as options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.VITEN.help: Ask which word can start the sentence like a noun (it begins with ku-).
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.VITEN.feedback: Nomino ya kitenzi-jina huanza na ku-: kusoma, kucheza, kulima. Shina la kitenzi peke yake haliwezi kuwa nomino hapa.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.VITEN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.VITEN.error: Uses a conjugated verb (anasoma) as the verbal noun.

example.question: ___ ni muhimu kwa kila mtoto.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.VITEN.cause: The child sees a verb and does not tell it apart from the verbal noun.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.VITEN.reveals: A conjugated verb among the options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.VITEN.help: Ask whether the word says who is doing it and when.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.VITEN.feedback: Anasoma ni kitenzi chenye mtu na wakati. Kitenzi-jina ni kusoma, kinachotumika kama nomino bila mtu wala wakati.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.VITEN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.VITEN.error: Uses the doer noun (msomaji, mkulima) for the action noun.

example.question: ___ kunakuza akili.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.VITEN.cause: Both words come from the same verb and look alike.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.VITEN.reveals: The doer noun among the options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.VITEN.help: Ask whether the gap names the action or the person who does it.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.VITEN.feedback: Msomaji ni mtu anayesoma. Kitenzi-jina hutaja kitendo chenyewe: kusoma.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.VITEN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.VITEN.error: Gives a verbal noun the agreement of a person or a thing (kusoma anafurahisha, kusoma kinafurahisha) instead of ku-.

example.question: Jaza: Kusoma ___ (kunafurahisha / anafurahisha).

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.VITEN.cause: The child has not yet met KU-KU and copies the agreement he knows best.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.VITEN.reveals: The question "Jaza: Kusoma ___ (kunafurahisha / anafurahisha)." with "anafurahisha" among the options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.VITEN.help: A verbal noun keeps ku- in the verb that follows: kusoma kunafurahisha.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T2_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.VITEN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.error: Takes a methali for a riddle.

example.question: Ni kitendawili kipi?

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.help: A riddle asks a hidden question and waits for the answer.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.feedback: Kitendawili huficha jibu na humtaka mtu kukitegua. Methali hutoa funzo.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.error: Takes a nahau for a riddle.

example.question: Ni kitendawili kipi?

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.cause: Both can be a short phrase.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.help: Can you guess an answer to it?
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.feedback: Nahau ni maneno yenye maana maalum. Kitendawili huuliza kwa mafumbo na kina jibu la kutegua.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.error: Takes an ordinary sentence for a riddle.

example.question: Ni kitendawili kipi?

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.cause: The child does not see that a riddle hides the thing it describes.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.reveals: A riddle and a plain sentence.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.help: Does the text name the thing, or hide it?
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.feedback: Kitendawili hakitaji kitu moja kwa moja; hukielezea kwa fumbo. Sentensi ya kawaida inataja wazi.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.error: Gives a thing that shares one detail with the riddle but is not the answer.

example.question: "Popote niendapo hunifuata." Jibu ni nini?

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.cause: The child picks the first thing that comes to mind.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.help: Test each answer against every part of the riddle.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.feedback: Jibu la kitendawili lazima lilingane na kila sehemu yake. Hiyo si jibu sahihi.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.error: Takes fast reading for fluent reading, or very slow reading for careful reading.

example.question: Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma ni ipi?
example.correct_answer: Si haraka sana wala polepole sana

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.cause: The child thinks the best reader is the fastest.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.reveals: A question on speed with extremes as options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.help: Ask whether the listener can follow every word.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.feedback: Kusoma kwa ufasaha si kusoma haraka sana. Kasi ifaayo ni ya wastani, ili msikilizaji aelewe kila neno.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.error: Takes a loud voice for a fitting voice.

example.question: Sauti ipasavyo wakati wa kusoma ni ipi?
example.correct_answer: Sauti inayosikika wazi bila kupiga kelele

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.cause: The child thinks louder is better.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.reveals: A question on the voice with shouting and whispering as options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.help: Ask whether the voice is clear and comfortable to listen to.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.feedback: Sauti ipasavyo ni ile inayosikika wazi bila kupiga kelele wala kunong'ona.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.error: Reads on without a pause at the koma and the kikomo.

example.question: Ukifika kwenye koma wakati wa kusoma, ufanye nini?

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.cause: The child reads word after word and does not use the marks.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.reveals: A question on the pause at a koma or a kikomo.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.help: Read the sentence aloud and listen to where the voice rests.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.feedback: Alama za uakifishi zinatuonyesha mahali pa kupumzika: kidogo kwenye koma na kwa muda mrefu zaidi kwenye kikomo.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Bibi alivaa shanga nyekundu na bangili za fedha."?
example.wrong_answer: Bibi ... alivaa ... shanga ... nyekundu ... na ... bangili ... za ... fedha.
example.correct_answer: Bibi alivaa shanga nyekundu na bangili za fedha.

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: The child is still decoding each word and has not yet learnt to read a phrase as one piece.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Bibi alivaa shanga nyekundu na bangili za fedha."?" with "Bibi ... alivaa ... shanga ... nyekundu ... na ... bangili ... za ... fedha." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it as one breath; then phrase-cut the passage with slashes.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Usomaji wa ufasaha husoma kundi la maneno kwa pamoja, kama tunavyozungumza.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, ili kila neno lisikike

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; the child has not been asked whether listeners understood.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Time two readings: one very fast, one at speaking pace; listeners answer one question after each.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ile ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads a question and an exclamation in the same flat voice as a statement.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, umewahi kuvaa hereni za dhahabu?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the mark at the end.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, umewahi kuvaa hereni za dhahabu?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that matches each reading.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; alama ya hisi (!) huonyesha hisia.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads on through the koma and the kikomo without a pause.

example.question: Unasoma: "Lo, kanga yako inapendeza mno!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?
example.wrong_answer: hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja
example.correct_answer: kwenye koma na kwenye kikomo au alama ya hisi

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: The marks are read as decoration; the child has not linked them to breath.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Unasoma: "Lo, kanga yako inapendeza mno!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?" with "hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Clap once at a koma, twice at a kikomo while reading together.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Simama kidogo kwenye koma, na zaidi kwenye kikomo.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Says /l/ for /r/ or /r/ for /l/ while reading (hereni read as heleni).

example.question: Neno "hereni" linatamkwa vipi?

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: The first language of the child does not separate these sounds, so the reading carries the home sound.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Neno "hereni" linatamkwa vipi?" with "heleni" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Make a list of the passage words with the hard sound; practise them before reading the passage.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Tamka "hereni" kama lilivyoandikwa; "heleni" ni neno jingine au si neno.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.error: Thinks a fluent reader keeps his eyes on the book all the time.

example.question: Ni kipi ni kipengele cha kusoma kwa ufasaha?

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.cause: Reading has only been practised for accuracy.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.reveals: The question "Ni kipi ni kipengele cha kusoma kwa ufasaha?" with "kuangalia kitabu tu" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.help: Watch a news reader on TV: when does he look up?
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.feedback: Msomaji mzuri huwaangalia wasikilizaji mara kwa mara.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.error: Confuses the parts of the computer (kipanya for kibodi, skrini for kitengo kikuu).

example.question: Sehemu ya kupigia herufi ni ipi?

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.cause: The child has used the computer but does not know the names.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.reveals: Names of the parts and what each does.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.help: Which part has keys with letters?
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.feedback: Kibodi ina vitufe vya herufi vya kupigia chapa. Kipanya hutumika kusogeza kielekezi, na skrini huonyesha kilichoandikwa.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.error: Gives the wrong job for the part (kichapishi shows the screen).

example.question: Kichapishi hufanya nini?

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.cause: The child knows the word but not what it is for.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.feedback: Kichapishi huchapisha kwenye karatasi. Skrini ndiyo huonyesha maandishi.

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.C.feedback: Weka kishale mahali pa kosa na ufute herufi hiyo tu.

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.C.error: Saves over a classmate's file or in a place he cannot find (the desktop of another user).

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.C.cause: The child presses Save and accepts whatever the computer offers.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.C.reveals: The question "Unahifadhi insha yako. Ni wapi pafaa?" with "popote, kwa jina "insha"" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.C.help: Open the Save window together: choose the folder, type the name, then save.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.C.feedback: Chagua folda yako na uandike jina linaloeleza kazi.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.C.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.C.error: Tries to make a title bold by typing it again in capitals or with stars (*Mapambo*).

example.question: Unataka anwani "MAPAMBO" iwe na herufi nzito. Ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: chagua anwani kisha bonyeza B (herufi nzito)

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.C.cause: The child knows formatting from chat apps, where stars make bold.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.C.reveals: The question "Unataka anwani "MAPAMBO" iwe na herufi nzito. Ufanye nini?" with "iandike mara mbili" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.C.help: Select the word, then press the B button; watch it change.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.C.feedback: Chagua neno kwanza, kisha bonyeza B.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.C.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.C.error: Types a space before the comma or full stop, and none after it (Shanga ,bangili .).

example.question: Ni ipi imechapwa sawa?

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.C.cause: On paper the gap is not seen; on screen the child presses space before every mark.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.C.reveals: The question "Ni ipi imechapwa sawa?" with "Shanga ,bangili na hereni ." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.C.help: Rule: the mark sticks to the word before it; the space comes after.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.C.feedback: Alama hukaa karibu na neno lililotangulia; nafasi hufuata alama.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.C.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.error: Mixes the jobs of the special keys (Shift for a space, Enter for a capital).

example.question: Ni kitufe kipi hutumika kuandika herufi kubwa moja?

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.cause: The child has seen the keys but not used each for its job.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.reveals: The question "Ni kitufe kipi hutumika kuandika herufi kubwa moja?" with "Enter" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.help: Label the four special keys and practise each in a typing game.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.feedback: Shift huandika herufi kubwa; Enter huanzisha mstari mpya.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.error: Thinks the printer (kichapishi) shows the work and the screen prints it.

example.question: Kichapishi hufanya kazi gani?
example.correct_answer: hutoa nakala ya kazi kwenye karatasi

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.cause: Both show the work; the child mixes which part shows and which prints.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.reveals: The question "Kichapishi hufanya kazi gani?" with "huonyesha kazi" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.help: Print one page in front of the class; compare with the screen.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.feedback: Skrini huonyesha kazi; kichapishi huitoa kwenye karatasi.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.MAKUNDI.error: Uses the group word of another group (jeshi for ndizi, umati for kuni).

example.question: Mama alinunua ___ wa ndizi sokoni.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.MAKUNDI.cause: The child knows group words but not which one goes with which thing.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.MAKUNDI.reveals: Group nouns for people, vehicles and fruit in one question.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.MAKUNDI.help: Ask "Kundi hili ni la nini?" and think of the usual word.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.MAKUNDI.feedback: Kila kundi lina jina lake la kawaida: umati wa watu, jeshi la askari, msafara wa magari, mkungu wa ndizi, tita la kuni.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.MAKUNDI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.MAKUNDI.error: Picks the name of one thing (mtu, gari, ndizi) where a group noun is needed.

example.question: Alipofika sokoni, aliona ___ wa watu wengi.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.MAKUNDI.cause: The child looks for a noun that fits the topic and does not see that a group is meant.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.MAKUNDI.reveals: A single noun among the options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.MAKUNDI.help: Ask whether the gap names one or many.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.MAKUNDI.feedback: Nomino ya kundi hutaja wengi kwa pamoja, kama umati wa watu. "Mtu" ni mmoja tu.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.MAKUNDI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.MAKUNDI.error: Gives the plural of the thing (ndizi nyingi) where the group noun (chane la ndizi) is asked.

example.question: Ndizi nyingi zilizoshikana pamoja huitwa?

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.MAKUNDI.cause: The child answers with the plural he already knows instead of the special group word.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.MAKUNDI.reveals: The question "Ndizi nyingi zilizoshikana pamoja huitwa?" with "ndizi nyingi" among the options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.MAKUNDI.help: Pair the picture of the group with its word: chane la ndizi, kundi la ng'ombe, umati wa watu.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.MAKUNDI.feedback: Kundi la ndizi zilizoshikana huitwa chane.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.MAKUNDI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.MAKUNDI.error: Agrees the verb with the things in the group, not with the group noun (kundi la ng'ombe wanakula).

example.question: Jaza: Kundi la ng'ombe ___ nyasi.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.MAKUNDI.cause: The child thinks of the cows, which are many, not of the word kundi.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.MAKUNDI.reveals: The question "Jaza: Kundi la ng'ombe ___ nyasi." with "wanakula" among the options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.MAKUNDI.help: Find the head noun (kundi): the verb agrees with it, li- in LI-YA.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.MAKUNDI.feedback: Kitenzi hupatana na kundi: kundi linakula.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO.MAKUNDI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.AMBAT.error: Takes a long simple noun (mwalimu, daktari) for a compound noun.

example.question: Mtoto anayesoma shuleni ni ___.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.AMBAT.cause: A long word looks as if it is built from parts.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.AMBAT.reveals: Simple and compound nouns in one question.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.AMBAT.help: Ask whether the word is two words joined, such as mwana + funzi.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.AMBAT.feedback: Nomino ambata huundwa kwa kuunganisha maneno mawili, kama mwana + funzi = mwanafunzi. Mwalimu si ambata.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.AMBAT.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.AMBAT.error: Writes a compound noun as two words (mwana funzi).

example.question: Mtoto anayesoma shuleni ni ___.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.AMBAT.cause: The child sees two parts and writes them apart, as in English.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.AMBAT.reveals: A gap where a split form is an option.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.AMBAT.help: Say it as one word and write it as one word.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.AMBAT.feedback: Nomino ambata huandikwa kama neno moja: mwanafunzi, si "mwana funzi".
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.AMBAT.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.AMBAT.error: Adds a hyphen to a compound that is written as one word (mwana-funzi), or joins one that is written with a hyphen.

example.question: Ni ipi imeandikwa sawa?

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.AMBAT.cause: Hyphens are seen in some compounds (bata-mzinga) and the child adds them everywhere.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.AMBAT.reveals: The question "Ni ipi imeandikwa sawa?" with "mwana-funzi" among the options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.AMBAT.help: Keep a list of compounds the way the dictionary writes them; check each new one there.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.AMBAT.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.AMBAT.error: Takes a noun with its describing word (nyumba kubwa) for a compound noun.

example.question: Ni ipi ni nomino ambata?

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.AMBAT.cause: Any two words together look like a compound.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.AMBAT.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni nomino ambata?" with "nyumba kubwa" among the options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.AMBAT.help: Ask whether the two words make one new name with its own meaning (mwanasheria is a lawyer, not a child of the law).
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.AMBAT.feedback: Nomino ambata ni jina moja jipya lenye maana yake: mwanasheria, mwanamke.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_2.AMBAT.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_3.DHAHA.error: Picks a thing that can be touched (mti, kitabu) as an abstract noun.

example.question: Nomino ya dhahania ni ipi?

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_3.DHAHA.cause: The child has not fixed that an abstract noun is an idea or feeling you cannot touch.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_3.DHAHA.reveals: A concrete noun and an abstract noun as options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_3.DHAHA.help: Ask "Ninaweza kuishika kwa mkono?" If yes, it is not dhahania.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_3.DHAHA.feedback: Kitabu kinaweza kushikwa kwa mkono. Nomino ya dhahania haishikiki: ni wazo au hisia, kama upendo.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_3.DHAHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_3.DHAHA.error: Gives the verb (kupenda, kuwa mkarimu) where the abstract noun (upendo, ukarimu) is needed.

example.question: Mama ana moyo wa ___.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_3.DHAHA.cause: The verb and the noun come from the same idea.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_3.DHAHA.reveals: A gap with a verb and its noun as options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_3.DHAHA.help: Ask which word can follow "wa" like a name of a feeling.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_3.DHAHA.feedback: Kupenda ni kitenzi. Nomino ya dhahania inayotokana nacho ni upendo.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_3.DHAHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_3.DHAHA.error: Gives the word for the person (mkarimu, mwongo) where the abstract noun (ukarimu, uongo) is needed.

example.question: Bibi yetu ana ___ mwingi.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_3.DHAHA.cause: The child does not change m- (person) to u- (idea).
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_3.DHAHA.reveals: A gap where the person word and the idea word are options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_3.DHAHA.feedback: Mkarimu ni mtu mwenye tabia hiyo. Nomino ya dhahania ni ukarimu, yaani tabia yenyewe.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_3.DHAHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_3.DHAHA.error: Gives the describing word (mwenye furaha, mzuri) where the abstract noun (furaha, uzuri) is needed.

example.question: Jaza: ___ wake ulituvutia sote (zuri).

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_3.DHAHA.cause: The adjective is the form the child uses most.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_3.DHAHA.reveals: The question "Jaza: ___ wake ulituvutia sote (zuri)." with "Mzuri" among the options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_3.DHAHA.help: Change the m- of the adjective to u- to make the idea: mzuri -> uzuri, mrefu -> urefu.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_3.DHAHA.feedback: Kutoka kivumishi: mzuri -> uzuri (nomino ya dhahania).
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_AINA_ZA_NOMINO_3.DHAHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.UAKIFISHI.M_.error: Starts a sentence or a name with a small letter.

example.question: Chagua sentensi sahihi.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.UAKIFISHI.M_.cause: Carelessness in a hurried hand or on a phone, or not seeing a name as a name.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.UAKIFISHI.M_.reveals: Two sentences that differ only in the capital letter.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.UAKIFISHI.M_.help: Look at the first letter of the sentence and of every name.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.UAKIFISHI.M_.feedback: Sentensi huanza kwa herufi kubwa, na majina ya watu na mahali pia huandikwa kwa herufi kubwa.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.UAKIFISHI.M_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.UAKIFISHI.M_.error: Ends a question with a kikomo (.) or a statement with a kiulizi (?).

example.question: Chagua sentensi sahihi.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.UAKIFISHI.M_.cause: The child does not read the sentence as a question.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.UAKIFISHI.M_.reveals: A question ended with a full stop and with a question mark.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.UAKIFISHI.M_.help: Say it aloud: does your voice go up as if you ask?
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.UAKIFISHI.M_.feedback: Swali humalizika kwa kiulizi (?). Sentensi ya kawaida humalizika kwa kikomo (.).
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.UAKIFISHI.M_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.UAKIFISHI.M_.error: Leaves out the koma between things in a list or after a greeting word.

example.question: Chagua sentensi sahihi.
example.wrong_answer: Mama alinunua mchele sukari na chumvi.
example.correct_answer: Mama alinunua mchele, sukari na chumvi.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.UAKIFISHI.M_.cause: The child writes as he speaks, without the pause.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.UAKIFISHI.M_.reveals: A list written with and without koma.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.UAKIFISHI.M_.help: Where would you pause when you read the list aloud?
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.UAKIFISHI.M_.feedback: Koma hutenganisha vitu katika orodha. Weka koma baada ya kila kitu isipokuwa kabla ya "na" ya mwisho.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.UAKIFISHI.M_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.UAKIFISHI.M_.error: Writes a common noun in the middle of a sentence with a capital letter.

example.question: Chagua sentensi sahihi.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.UAKIFISHI.M_.cause: Habit from English headings or from names.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.UAKIFISHI.M_.reveals: A sentence with a capital on a common noun.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.UAKIFISHI.M_.help: Ask whether the word is the name of one person or place.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.UAKIFISHI.M_.feedback: Herufi kubwa hutumika mwanzo wa sentensi na kwa majina ya pekee tu. Nomino ya kawaida katikati ya sentensi huandikwa kwa herufi ndogo.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T3_UAKIFISHI.UAKIFISHI.M_.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T4_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.error: Swaps the father's side and the mother's side (shangazi and mjomba).

example.question: Dada ya baba yako anaitwaje?

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T4_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.cause: The child knows the words but not the sides.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T4_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.reveals: Relations from the father's and the mother's sides.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T4_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.help: Shangazi is a woman (the father's sister); mjomba is a man (the mother's brother).

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_I_ZI.I_ZI.M_I.reveals: A gap with the ki-vi prefixes as options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_I_ZI.I_ZI.M_I.help: Ask "Meza inapatana na kitabu au na nyumba?"
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_I_ZI.I_ZI.M_I.feedback: Si kila kitu hutumia ki-/vi-. Meza, nyumba na barabara ni za ngeli ya I-ZI, kwa hiyo wingi hutumia zi-.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_I_ZI.I_ZI.M_I.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_I_ZI.I_ZI.M_I.error: Makes the plural of an I-ZI noun by adding ma- or a plural prefix (manyumba, mezazi).

example.question: Wingi wa "Nyumba ni kubwa" ni ___.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_I_ZI.I_ZI.M_I.cause: The child thinks every noun must change to show many.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_I_ZI.I_ZI.M_I.reveals: Plural sentences with a changed noun and with an unchanged noun.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_I_ZI.I_ZI.M_I.help: Ask whether this noun has a different plural form.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_I_ZI.I_ZI.M_I.feedback: Nomino za I-ZI haziongezi kiambishi katika wingi. Tunabadilisha viambishi vya upatanisho: nyumba zote ni kubwa.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_I_ZI.I_ZI.M_I.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M_MET_.error: Reads the methali word for word.

example.question: Mchumia juani hulia kivulini. Maana yake ni nini?
example.correct_answer: Anayefanya kazi kwa bidii hufurahia matunda yake baadaye

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M_MET_.cause: The child does not know that a methali carries a second meaning.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M_MET_.reveals: A meaning question with a literal option.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M_MET_.help: Ask what lesson the methali teaches.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M_MET_.feedback: Methali haisemi maana yake wazi. Mchumia juani hulia kivulini ina maana kwamba anayefanya kazi kwa bidii atapumzika na kufurahia matunda yake.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M_MET_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M_MET_.error: Gives the lesson of another methali.

example.question: Haba na haba hujaza kibaba. Maana yake ni nini?
example.correct_answer: Vitu vidogo vikiongezwa polepole huwa vingi

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M_MET_.cause: The child knows methali but swaps their lessons.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M_MET_.reveals: The meaning of a different methali as an option.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M_MET_.help: Ask what the words say about little and little.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M_MET_.feedback: Kila methali ina funzo lake. Haba na haba hujaza kibaba inafundisha kwamba kidogo kidogo hujaza.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M_MET_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M_MET_.error: Completes the methali with a word that does not belong to it.

example.question: Haba na haba hujaza ___.

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M_MET_.cause: The child remembers the beginning but not the end.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M_MET_.reveals: A gap where a plausible wrong ending is an option.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M_MET_.help: Say the whole methali again from the beginning.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M_MET_.feedback: Methali hubaki jinsi ilivyo. Mwisho sahihi ni kibaba: haba na haba hujaza kibaba.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M_MET_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M5_MET.error: Uses a methali on hard work where its lesson does not fit the story (a lazy man rewarded).

example.question: Juma alilala badala ya kulima, mavuno yalipofika hakupata kitu. Methali ipi inafaa?

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M5_MET.cause: The child knows several methali on hard work and picks any of them.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M5_MET.reveals: The question "Juma alilala badala ya kulima, mavuno yalipofika hakupata kitu. Methali ipi inafaa?" with "Haba na haba hujaza kibaba" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M5_MET.help: Read the situation, say its lesson in one sentence, then find the methali with the same lesson.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M5_MET.feedback: Chagua methali yenye funzo linalolingana na kisa.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.M5_MET.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.error: Counts the words of the line, not the mizani.

example.question: Mshororo "Mama anapika" una mizani mingapi?

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.cause: The child counts what he can see.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.reveals: A line with few words and many mizani.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.feedback: Mizani ni silabi, yaani sehemu za sauti. Hesabu silabi (ma-ma a-na-pi-ka), si maneno.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

example.question: Mshororo "Nenda shule" una mizani mingapi?

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.reveals: A line with an option equal to its letter count.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.help: Count vowels: each vowel starts a new silabi in Kiswahili.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.feedback: Mizani si herufi. Kwa kawaida kila irabu huanza silabi: ne-nda shu-le ni mizani 5.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.error: Looks at the start of the lines, not the end, to find vina.

example.question: Vina vya mishororo hii ni vipi?

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.help: Vina are the endings that sound alike.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.feedback: Vina ni sauti za mwisho zinazofanana katika mishororo. Tazama mwisho wa kila mshororo.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.error: Says the whole last word must be the same for the lines to rhyme.

example.question: Mishororo "shambani" na "nyumbani" ina vina vipi?

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.cause: The child thinks vina means the same word.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.reveals: Two lines that end differently but with the same sound.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.help: Say both endings aloud and listen to the last sounds.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.feedback: Vina ni sauti za mwisho zinazofanana, si neno lilelile. Shambani na nyumbani zina vina -ani.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.error: Miscounts the mizani by one, missing a vowel (the double vowel in bidii counted as one).

example.question: Mshororo "Soma kwa bidii" una mizani mingapi?

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.cause: The child counts "ii" or "ua" as one sound.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.reveals: A line with a double vowel.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.help: Clap each vowel: bi-di-i has three.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.feedback: Kila irabu ni silabi tofauti: bidii ni bi-di-i, yaani mizani 3. Hesabu kila irabu.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Tells a story of what happened where the insha should explain or describe.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kupambana na Umaskini Nyumbani"?
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, tunapanda mboga kwenye kitalu kidogo nyuma ya nyumba.

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: Stories are the kind of writing the child has done most and he falls back on it.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kupambana na Umaskini Nyumbani"?" with "Siku moja tulienda sokoni tukapotea." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Ask what the reader should know about the topic at the end: what it is, how it works or is done.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Insha ya maelezo hueleza jambo lilivyo au jinsi linavyofanywa, si matukio ya siku moja.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Describes with empty words (kizuri sana, kibaya) and no detail that makes a picture.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kupambana na Umaskini Nyumbani"?
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, tunapanda mboga kwenye kitalu kidogo nyuma ya nyumba.

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child knows the thing well and assumes the reader sees it too.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kupambana na Umaskini Nyumbani"?" with "Umaskini ni mbaya." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Five senses chart: what do you see, hear, smell, touch, taste? Turn one row into a sentence.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Gives the steps of how to do something in a mixed-up order.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Jinsi ya Kupambana na Umaskini Nyumbani"?
example.wrong_answer: weka akiba, uza ziada, panda mboga, panga bajeti
example.correct_answer: panga bajeti, panda mboga, uza ziada, weka akiba

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child remembers the steps as a set, not as a sequence.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Jinsi ya Kupambana na Umaskini Nyumbani"?" with "weka akiba, uza ziada, panda mboga, panga bajeti" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Act out the steps; number them; write them with kwanza, kisha, mwishowe.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Maelezo ya jinsi ya kufanya jambo hufuata hatua kwa mpangilio.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kupambana na Umaskini Nyumbani", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, tunapanda mboga kwenye kitalu kidogo nyuma ya nyumba.

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kupambana na Umaskini Nyumbani", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Writes the whole insha as one paragraph with no utangulizi, kiini and hitimisho.

example.question: Insha "Jinsi ya Kupambana na Umaskini Nyumbani" ina sehemu zipi?

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child writes until the space is full and has not planned the parts.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Insha "Jinsi ya Kupambana na Umaskini Nyumbani" ina sehemu zipi?" with "aya moja ndefu" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Fold the page into three; one part in each; one idea per paragraph in the middle.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Insha ina utangulizi, kiini chenye aya kadhaa, na hitimisho.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T5_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_ZI.U_ZI.M_U.error: Puts ma- or mi- on the plural of a U-ZI noun (maukuta, mikuta).

example.question: Wingi wa "ukuta" ni ___.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_ZI.U_ZI.M_U.cause: The child changes u- to the prefixes he knows best.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_ZI.U_ZI.M_U.reveals: Plural forms of nouns of U-ZI.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_ZI.U_ZI.M_U.help: Ask whether you hear "mi" in a plural of ukuta in the house.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_ZI.U_ZI.M_U.feedback: Katika ngeli ya U-ZI, tunaondoa u- au kubadili herufi za mwanzo: ukuta - kuta, wimbo - nyimbo, ubao - mbao.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_ZI.U_ZI.M_U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_ZI.U_ZI.M_U.error: Agrees a U-ZI noun with i- (as in U-I) instead of zi- in the plural.

example.question: Kuta mbili ___meanguka.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_ZI.U_ZI.M_U.cause: U-I and U-ZI both begin with u- in the singular.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_ZI.U_ZI.M_U.reveals: A plural gap with i- and zi- as options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_ZI.U_ZI.M_U.help: Does the plural noun have mi- (like miti) or not?
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_ZI.U_ZI.M_U.feedback: Wingi wa nomino za U-ZI hupatana na zi-: kuta zimeanguka. Mi- ni ya ngeli nyingine, kama miti.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_ZI.U_ZI.M_U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_ZI.U_ZI.M_U.error: Uses a wrong prefix (a-, ki- or i-) with a singular noun of U-ZI.

example.question: Ukuta ___meanguka.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_ZI.U_ZI.M_U.cause: The child guesses a prefix from the sound of the noun.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_ZI.U_ZI.M_U.reveals: A singular gap with u-, i-, a- and ki- as options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_ZI.U_ZI.M_U.help: Look at the first letter of the noun: it often gives the prefix.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_ZI.U_ZI.M_U.feedback: Umoja wa ngeli ya U-ZI hupatana na u-: ukuta umeanguka.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_ZI.U_ZI.M_U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_ZI.U_ZI.M5_.error: Gives the wrong plural noun for a U-ZI noun (ukuta -> kuta is right; the child says ukuta -> mikuta or uta).

example.question: Wingi wa "ukuta" ni upi?

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_ZI.U_ZI.M5_.cause: The plural of U-ZI drops u- and sometimes changes the stem (ufunguo -> funguo, ukuta -> kuta); the child adds a plural prefix he knows.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_ZI.U_ZI.M5_.reveals: The question "Wingi wa "ukuta" ni upi?" with "mikuta" among the options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_ZI.U_ZI.M5_.help: List pairs: ufunguo/funguo, ukuta/kuta, uzi/nyuzi, ubao/mbao; say both forms aloud.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_ZI.U_ZI.M5_.feedback: Wingi wa ukuta ni kuta: u- inaondoka.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_ZI.U_ZI.M5_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T6_USHAIRI.USHAIRI_MAADIL.error: Gives one line of the poem, word for word, as its message.

example.question: Shairi linasema: "Heshima ni kitu bora, tumheshimu kila mtu." Ujumbe wa shairi ni upi?
example.correct_answer: tuwaheshimu watu wote ili tuishi vizuri

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T6_USHAIRI.USHAIRI_MAADIL.cause: Copying a line feels safe; the child has not been asked to say the message in his own words.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T6_USHAIRI.USHAIRI_MAADIL.reveals: The question "Shairi linasema: "Heshima ni kitu bora, tumheshimu kila mtu." Ujumbe wa shairi ni upi?" with "Heshima ni kitu bora" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T6_USHAIRI.USHAIRI_MAADIL.help: After reading, close the poem and ask the child to say what the poet wants, without the poem's words.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T6_USHAIRI.USHAIRI_MAADIL.feedback: Ujumbe ni funzo la shairi lote kwa maneno yako mwenyewe.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T6_USHAIRI.USHAIRI_MAADIL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T6_USHAIRI.USHAIRI_MAADIL.error: Recites the whole poem in one flat tone and pace, with no beat and no pause between beti.

example.question: Unakariri shairi. Ni lipi ni bora?
example.wrong_answer: kusoma maneno yote kwa kasi moja bila kusimama
example.correct_answer: kufuata mahadhi ya shairi na kusimama kidogo baada ya kila ubeti

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T6_USHAIRI.USHAIRI_MAADIL.cause: The child treats reciting as saying words from memory as fast as possible.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T6_USHAIRI.USHAIRI_MAADIL.reveals: The question "Unakariri shairi. Ni lipi ni bora?" with "kusoma maneno yote kwa kasi moja bila kusimama" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T6_USHAIRI.USHAIRI_MAADIL.help: Clap the mizani of one line; recite it with the claps; pause at the end of the ubeti.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T6_USHAIRI.USHAIRI_MAADIL.feedback: Kariri kwa mahadhi: fuata mapigo ya mizani na usimame mwisho wa ubeti.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T6_USHAIRI.USHAIRI_MAADIL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T6_USHAIRI.USHAIRI_MAADIL.error: Gives the everyday meaning of a word, not its meaning in the line (taji as a crown only, where the poem means honour).

example.question: "Adabu ni taji la mtoto." Neno "taji" lina maana gani hapa?

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T6_USHAIRI.USHAIRI_MAADIL.cause: The child knows one meaning of the word and does not test it against the line.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T6_USHAIRI.USHAIRI_MAADIL.reveals: The question ""Adabu ni taji la mtoto." Neno "taji" lina maana gani hapa?" with "kofia ya mfalme ya dhahabu" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T6_USHAIRI.USHAIRI_MAADIL.help: Read the line with each meaning in place; keep the one that makes sense.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T6_USHAIRI.USHAIRI_MAADIL.feedback: Katika shairi, neno linaweza kuwa na maana ya picha: taji hapa ni fahari.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T6_USHAIRI.USHAIRI_MAADIL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T6_USHAIRI.USHAIRI_MAADIL.error: Answers a question on the poem from what he thinks is right, not from what the poem says.

example.question: Kwa mujibu wa shairi, kwa nini tuwaheshimu wazee?
example.correct_answer: kwa sababu wana hekima na wametulea

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T6_USHAIRI.USHAIRI_MAADIL.cause: The question sounds like a question about life, so the child answers from life.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T6_USHAIRI.USHAIRI_MAADIL.reveals: The question "Kwa mujibu wa shairi, kwa nini tuwaheshimu wazee?" with "kwa sababu ni matajiri" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T6_USHAIRI.USHAIRI_MAADIL.help: Ask for the line that gives the answer before accepting it.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T6_USHAIRI.USHAIRI_MAADIL.feedback: Jibu swali kwa kutumia maneno ya shairi.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T6_USHAIRI.USHAIRI_MAADIL.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.error: Takes a story (with characters and events) for an article.

example.question: Ni ipi ni makala?

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.cause: Both are read in the library and both have a title.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni makala?" with "Hadithi ya Sungura na Fisi" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.help: Show the signs of an article: facts or advice on a topic, headings, no "Hapo zamani".
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.feedback: Makala hueleza jambo kwa ukweli; hadithi husimulia kisa cha wahusika.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.error: Looks for an article among the storybooks, or picks the first thing on the shelf.

example.question: Unatafuta makala kuhusu maadili maktabani. Utaanzia wapi?
example.wrong_answer: kwenye rafu ya hadithi za watoto
example.correct_answer: kwenye rafu ya magazeti na majarida au vitabu vya maarifa

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.cause: The child has only used the storybook corner.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.reveals: The question "Unatafuta makala kuhusu maadili maktabani. Utaanzia wapi?" with "kwenye rafu ya hadithi za watoto" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.help: Walk the library: label shelves (hadithi, mashairi, maarifa, magazeti).
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.feedback: Makala hupatikana katika magazeti, majarida na vitabu vya maarifa.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.error: Gives the example in the article (one boy returned a lost wallet) as its main point.

example.question: Wazo kuu la makala "Faida za Uaminifu" ni lipi?
example.correct_answer: Uaminifu huleta heshima na imani kati ya watu.

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.cause: The example is a little story and is remembered; the child has not separated it from the point it supports.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.reveals: The question "Wazo kuu la makala "Faida za Uaminifu" ni lipi?" with "Kijana mmoja alirudisha pochi iliyopotea." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.help: Ask: is this the point, or an example that shows the point?
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.feedback: Mfano huonyesha wazo kuu; si wazo kuu lenyewe.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.error: Reads only the title and the first line and answers from them.

example.question: Makala yana aya nne. Jibu la swali la tatu liko aya ya tatu. Ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: soma aya zote, hasa aya ya tatu, kabla ya kujibu

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.cause: The child wants to finish quickly and trusts the title.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.reveals: The question "Makala yana aya nne. Jibu la swali la tatu liko aya ya tatu. Ufanye nini?" with "jibu kutoka anwani" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.help: Number the paragraphs; for each question, find the paragraph first.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.feedback: Soma makala yote kabla ya kujibu.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.error: Tells a story of what happened where the insha should describe the person, place or thing.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya wasifu kuhusu "Mwalimu Wangu Mwadilifu"?
example.correct_answer: Mwalimu Achieng ni mrefu, mpole na husikiliza kila mwanafunzi kwa makini.

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.cause: Stories are the kind of writing the child has done most and he falls back on it.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya wasifu kuhusu "Mwalimu Wangu Mwadilifu"?" with "Siku moja tulienda sokoni tukapotea." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.help: Ask what the reader should know about the topic at the end: what it looks like, what it is for.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.feedback: Insha ya wasifu hueleza jinsi kitu au mtu alivyo, si matukio ya siku moja.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.error: Describes with empty words (kizuri sana, kibaya) and no detail that makes a picture.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Mwalimu Wangu Mwadilifu"?
example.correct_answer: Mwalimu Achieng ni mrefu, mpole na husikiliza kila mwanafunzi kwa makini.

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.cause: The child knows the thing well and assumes the reader sees it too.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Mwalimu Wangu Mwadilifu"?" with "Mwalimu wetu ni mzuri." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.help: Five senses chart: what do you see, hear, smell, touch, taste? Turn one row into a sentence.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.feedback: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.error: Uses a describing word that does not agree with its noun (bendera mzuri, miti mrefu).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni sahihi?

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.cause: The child uses one form of the adjective (m-) for every noun, as he hears it for people.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ni sahihi?" with "Ana macho mikubwa ya upole." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.help: Find the noun first, then its ngeli, then the prefix of the adjective.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.feedback: Kivumishi hupatana na nomino yake: bendera nzuri, miti mirefu, mtoto mzuri.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya wasifu yenye anwani "Mwalimu Wangu Mwadilifu", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Mwalimu Achieng ni mrefu, mpole na husikiliza kila mwanafunzi kwa makini.

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya wasifu yenye anwani "Mwalimu Wangu Mwadilifu", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.error: Writes the whole insha as one paragraph with no utangulizi, kiini and hitimisho.

example.question: Insha "Mwalimu Wangu Mwadilifu" ina sehemu zipi?

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.cause: The child writes until the space is full and has not planned the parts.
