KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.reveals: The question "Insha "Mwalimu Wangu Mwadilifu" ina sehemu zipi?" with "aya moja ndefu" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.help: Fold the page into three; one part in each; one idea per paragraph in the middle.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.feedback: Insha ina utangulizi, kiini chenye aya kadhaa, na hitimisho.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T6_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.INSHA_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_U_YA.U_YA.M_U.error: Agrees the plural of a U-YA noun with zi- or i- instead of ya-.

example.question: Manyoya ___meanguka.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_U_YA.U_YA.M_U.cause: The child uses the prefix of the better known class.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_U_YA.U_YA.M_U.reveals: A plural gap with ya-, zi- and i- as options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_U_YA.U_YA.M_U.help: Does the plural noun begin with ma-?
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_U_YA.U_YA.M_U.feedback: Nomino za U-YA zina wingi wenye ma-, na zinapatana na ya-: manyoya yameanguka.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_U_YA.U_YA.M_U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_U_YA.U_YA.M_U.error: Gives a wrong plural for a U-YA noun (minyoya, nyoya, unyoya).

example.question: Wingi wa "unyoya" ni ___.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_U_YA.U_YA.M_U.cause: The child does not know that U-YA nouns take ma-.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_U_YA.U_YA.M_U.feedback: Wingi wa nomino za U-YA huundwa kwa ma-: unyoya - manyoya, ugonjwa - magonjwa, uchungu - machungu.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_U_YA.U_YA.M_U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_U_YA.U_YA.M_U.error: Agrees a singular U-YA noun with ya- or a- instead of u-.

example.question: Ugonjwa wake ___meisha.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_U_YA.U_YA.M_U.cause: The child sees the ya- he knows from the plural.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_U_YA.U_YA.M_U.reveals: A singular gap with ya- and u- as options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_U_YA.U_YA.M_U.help: One illness: u- as in ugonjwa.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_U_YA.U_YA.M_U.feedback: Umoja wa ngeli ya U-YA hupatana na u-: ugonjwa umepona.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_U_YA.U_YA.M_U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_U_YA.U_YA.M5_.error: Puts a U-YA noun in U-ZI because both start with u- (ugonjwa zimeenea).

example.question: Jaza: Magonjwa ___ (yameenea / zimeenea).

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_U_YA.U_YA.M5_.cause: Both classes begin with u- in the singular; the child takes the plural of the class he learnt first.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_U_YA.U_YA.M5_.reveals: The question "Jaza: Magonjwa ___ (yameenea / zimeenea)." with "zimeenea" among the options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_U_YA.U_YA.M5_.help: Plural test: if the plural takes ma- (ugonjwa -> magonjwa), the class is U-YA and the verb takes ya-.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_U_YA.U_YA.M5_.feedback: Ugonjwa ni wa U-YA: wingi ni magonjwa, na kitenzi huchukua ya-.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_U_YA.U_YA.M5_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_LITE.error: Reads the nahau word for word.

example.question: "Kukata tamaa" maana yake ni nini?

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_LITE.cause: The child does not know that a nahau has its own meaning.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_LITE.reveals: A meaning question with a literal option.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_LITE.help: Ask whether anyone really cuts tamaa.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_LITE.feedback: Nahau ina maana tofauti na maneno yake. "Kukata tamaa" ni kuacha kuwa na matumaini.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_LITE.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.error: Gives the meaning of another nahau.

example.question: "Kula chumvi" maana yake ni nini?
example.correct_answer: kuwa na umri mkubwa na uzoefu

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.cause: The child knows several nahau but swaps meanings.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.reveals: The meaning of another nahau as an option.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.help: Ask what experience chumvi stands for.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.feedback: Kila nahau ina maana yake. "Kula chumvi" ni kuwa na uzoefu wa miaka mingi.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.error: Completes the nahau with a different word (kukata moyo for kukata tamaa).

example.question: Usikate ___ ukishindwa mara moja.

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.cause: The child remembers the shape but changes a word.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.reveals: A nahau gap where a near word is an option.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.feedback: Nahau hazibadiliki: kukata tamaa, kupiga moyo konde. Neno moja likibadilika, maana hupotea.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M_NAH_WRON.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M5_NAH_USE.error: Uses the nahau in a sentence where its meaning does not fit (Alipiga deki mto).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi imetumia "kupiga deki" ipasavyo?
example.correct_answer: Mama alipiga deki sakafu ya nyumba.

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M5_NAH_USE.cause: The child knows the words of the nahau but not the situation it belongs to.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M5_NAH_USE.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi imetumia "kupiga deki" ipasavyo?" with "Mvuvi alipiga deki mto." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M5_NAH_USE.help: Ask what the nahau means, then whether the sentence describes that.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M5_NAH_USE.feedback: Kupiga deki ni kusafisha sakafu kwa maji; inatumiwa kwa sakafu.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.M5_NAH_USE.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Chooses a book by its cover picture or its thickness only.

example.question: Unataka kusoma kuhusu elimu ya mazingira. Utachaguaje kitabu?
example.correct_answer: kwa kusoma anwani, maelezo ya nyuma na ukurasa wa kwanza

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: Nobody has shown the child the title, the blurb and the first page as clues.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Unataka kusoma kuhusu elimu ya mazingira. Utachaguaje kitabu?" with "kwa picha nzuri ya jalada" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: Hold up two books; read the title and the back of each aloud; the child chooses and says which clue decided it.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Anwani, maelezo ya nyuma ya kitabu na ukurasa wa kwanza hukuambia kitabu kinahusu nini.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Chooses a text far above his reading level and gives up after a page.

example.question: Ukisoma ukurasa wa kwanza wa "Mto Wetu Unalia" na hujui maneno mengi sana, ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: chagua matini nyingine iliyo ya kiwango chako

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: The child thinks a harder book is a better book, or chooses the book a friend chose.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Ukisoma ukurasa wa kwanza wa "Mto Wetu Unalia" na hujui maneno mengi sana, ufanye nini?" with "endelea tu hata kama huelewi" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: The five-finger check: on one page, a finger for each unknown word; five fingers means the book is too hard for now.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Matini ifaayo ni ile unayoweza kuisoma na kuielewa ukiwa peke yako.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Gives the title as the message of the text.

example.question: Ujumbe wa matini "Mto Wetu Unalia" ni upi?

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: The title is the only sentence about the whole text that the child is sure of.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa matini "Mto Wetu Unalia" ni upi?" with "Mto Wetu Unalia" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: Ask what the writer wants the reader to learn or do; the title only names the topic.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Anwani hutaja mada; ujumbe ni funzo au wazo kuu ambalo mwandishi anataka ulipate.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Gives one detail of the text as its message.

example.question: Ni ipi ni ujumbe wa matini kuhusu elimu ya mazingira?
example.wrong_answer: Watoto waliokota chupa za plastiki kando ya mto.

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: The detail was striking and is remembered; the child has not asked what the whole text is about.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni ujumbe wa matini kuhusu elimu ya mazingira?" with "Watoto waliokota chupa za plastiki kando ya mto." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: Two boxes: "ujumbe" (one) and "maelezo" (many); the child sorts sentences from the text.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Ujumbe unahusu matini yote; jambo moja dogo ni maelezo tu.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Does not tell one kind of text from another (takes a newspaper report for a story, or a poem for a story).

example.question: Matini yenye beti na mishororo ni ya aina gani?

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: The child has met most texts as "kitabu" and has not been shown the signs of each kind.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Matini yenye beti na mishororo ni ya aina gani?" with "hadithi" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: Lay out a story, a poem, a newspaper page and a dictionary; the child names one sign of each.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Shairi lina beti na mishororo; hadithi ina aya; gazeti lina habari na tarehe.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Guesses a new word from how it looks, not from the sentence it is in (taka).

example.question: Katika matini: "Watu walitupa taka mtoni na maji yakachafuka." Neno "taka" lina maana gani?

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: The child matches the word to a word it looks like instead of reading the sentence around it.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Katika matini: "Watu walitupa taka mtoni na maji yakachafuka." Neno "taka" lina maana gani?" with "kutaka kitu" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: Cover the word; the child reads the sentence and says what word would fit; then compares.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Soma sentensi nzima: "taka" hapa ni vitu visivyotakiwa vinavyotupwa.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Tells a story of what happened where the insha should explain or describe.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kutunza Mazingira ya Shule"?
example.correct_answer: Kila Ijumaa, tunaokota taka na kuzitupa kwenye pipa la taka.

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: Stories are the kind of writing the child has done most and he falls back on it.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kutunza Mazingira ya Shule"?" with "Siku moja tulienda sokoni tukapotea." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Ask what the reader should know about the topic at the end: what it is, how it works or is done.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Insha ya maelezo hueleza jambo lilivyo au jinsi linavyofanywa, si matukio ya siku moja.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Describes with empty words (kizuri sana, kibaya) and no detail that makes a picture.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kutunza Mazingira ya Shule"?
example.correct_answer: Kila Ijumaa, tunaokota taka na kuzitupa kwenye pipa la taka.

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child knows the thing well and assumes the reader sees it too.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kutunza Mazingira ya Shule"?" with "Mazingira ni muhimu." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Five senses chart: what do you see, hear, smell, touch, taste? Turn one row into a sentence.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Gives the steps of how to do something in a mixed-up order.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Jinsi ya Kutunza Mazingira ya Shule"?
example.wrong_answer: panda maua, tupa kwenye pipa, tenganisha taka, okota taka
example.correct_answer: okota taka, tenganisha taka, tupa kwenye pipa, panda maua

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child remembers the steps as a set, not as a sequence.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Jinsi ya Kutunza Mazingira ya Shule"?" with "panda maua, tupa kwenye pipa, tenganisha taka, okota taka" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Act out the steps; number them; write them with kwanza, kisha, mwishowe.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Maelezo ya jinsi ya kufanya jambo hufuata hatua kwa mpangilio.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kutunza Mazingira ya Shule", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Kila Ijumaa, tunaokota taka na kuzitupa kwenye pipa la taka.

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kutunza Mazingira ya Shule", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Writes the whole insha as one paragraph with no utangulizi, kiini and hitimisho.

example.question: Insha "Jinsi ya Kutunza Mazingira ya Shule" ina sehemu zipi?

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child writes until the space is full and has not planned the parts.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Insha "Jinsi ya Kutunza Mazingira ya Shule" ina sehemu zipi?" with "aya moja ndefu" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Fold the page into three; one part in each; one idea per paragraph in the middle.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Insha ina utangulizi, kiini chenye aya kadhaa, na hitimisho.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T7_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KU_KU.KU_KU.M.error: Agrees a verbal noun with a- (a person) instead of ku-.

example.question: Kusoma ___napendeza.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KU_KU.KU_KU.M.cause: The child thinks of the person who reads, not of the action.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KU_KU.KU_KU.M.reveals: A gap with a-, u-, i- and ku- as options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KU_KU.KU_KU.M.help: The first word is kusoma, which begins with ku-.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KU_KU.KU_KU.M.feedback: Nomino za KU-KU hupatana na ku-: kusoma kunapendeza. A- ni ya mtu mmoja.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KU_KU.KU_KU.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KU_KU.KU_KU.M.error: Agrees a verbal noun with u- or i- as with U-I.

example.question: Kucheza ___nafurahisha.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KU_KU.KU_KU.M.cause: The child pairs ku- nouns with prefixes of the classes he knows best.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KU_KU.KU_KU.M.reveals: A gap with u-, i- and ku- as options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KU_KU.KU_KU.M.help: Say the sentence with the prefix that is the same as the noun starts with.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KU_KU.KU_KU.M.feedback: Kitenzi-jina hupatana na ku-, kama kinavyoanza: kucheza kunafurahisha.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KU_KU.KU_KU.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KU_KU.KU_KU.M.error: Gives a plural (makusoma, vikusoma) to a verbal noun.

example.question: Wingi wa "kusoma" ni ___.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KU_KU.KU_KU.M.cause: The child thinks every noun has a plural.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KU_KU.KU_KU.M.reveals: A plural question where the right answer is that nothing changes.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KU_KU.KU_KU.M.feedback: Nomino za KU-KU hazina wingi tofauti. Kusoma hubaki kusoma.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KU_KU.KU_KU.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KU_KU.KU_KU.M.error: Uses the possessive or adjective of another class with a verbal noun (kuimba yake, kusoma kizuri).

example.question: Jaza: Kuimba ___ kulifurahisha watu (kwake / yake).

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KU_KU.KU_KU.M.cause: The child agrees the possessive with the person who sings, not with the verbal noun.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KU_KU.KU_KU.M.reveals: The question "Jaza: Kuimba ___ kulifurahisha watu (kwake / yake)." with "yake" among the options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KU_KU.KU_KU.M.help: Everything that agrees with a verbal noun takes kw-/ku-: kuimba kwake, kusoma kuzuri.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KU_KU.KU_KU.M.feedback: Kitenzi-jina huchukua kw- katika kimilikishi: kuimba kwake.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KU_KU.KU_KU.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_OP.error: Picks the opposite where the same meaning is asked.

example.question: Kisawe cha "furaha" ni ___.

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_OP.cause: The child links furaha and huzuni because they go together.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_OP.reveals: A synonym question with the opposite as an option.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_OP.help: Ask whether the two words mean the same.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_OP.feedback: Visawe ni maneno yenye maana sawa. Furaha na huzuni ni vinyume, si visawe.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_OP.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_RE.error: Picks a word about the same topic but with a different meaning.

example.question: Kisawe cha "huzuni" ni ___.

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_RE.cause: The child picks what goes with the word, not what means the same.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_RE.reveals: A related word as an option.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_RE.help: Could you swap the two words in a sentence and keep the same meaning?
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_RE.feedback: Neno linalohusiana na jingine si lazima liwe na maana sawa nalo. Kisawe cha huzuni ni simanzi.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_RE.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_LO.error: Picks a word that looks or sounds like the word.

example.question: Kisawe cha "haraka" ni ___.

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_LO.cause: The child goes by the first letters.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_LO.reveals: A look-alike word as an option.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_LO.feedback: Maneno yanaweza kuanza kwa herufi zilezile na yasiwe na maana sawa. Kisawe cha haraka ni upesi.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M_VIS_LO.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M5_VIS_T.error: Finds two synonyms but adds a third word that is only related (pesa, fedha, mfuko).

example.question: Ni maneno yapi matatu yenye maana sawa?

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M5_VIS_T.cause: The related word (a purse holds money) belongs to the same picture, and the child counts it.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M5_VIS_T.reveals: The question "Ni maneno yapi matatu yenye maana sawa?" with "pesa, fedha, mfuko" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M5_VIS_T.help: Put each word into the same sentence; the one that changes the meaning is out.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M5_VIS_T.feedback: Mfuko ni mahali pa kuweka pesa, si jina lingine la pesa.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.M5_VIS_T.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.error: Reads the words in brackets (what to do on stage) as words a character says.

example.question: Maelekezo ya jukwaani katika igizo ni yapi?

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.cause: The child reads a play as a story.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.reveals: A play with brackets and spoken lines.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.help: Brackets tell the actor what to do, not what to say.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.feedback: Maneno yaliyo kwenye mabano ni maelekezo ya kitendo, si maneno ya mhusika. Hayasomwi kama mazungumzo.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.error: Does not tell a play from a story.

example.question: Ni kipi kati ya hivi ni igizo?

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.cause: The child sees a short text and does not look at the form.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.reveals: A play and a story on the same event.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.help: Look for the speaker names with a colon.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.feedback: Igizo huonyesha jina la mhusika, nukta mbili, kisha maneno anayosema. Hadithi huelezwa na msimulizi.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.error: Gives a character who did not say the line.

example.question: Nani alisema "Nitakuletea maji"?

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.cause: The child does not follow the names before the colons.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.help: Find the line and read the name before it.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.feedback: Jina lililo mbele ya nukta mbili ndilo la mtu anayesema maneno yaliyofuata.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.error: Gives a wrong detail of the play (the place, the thing bought).

example.question: Akinyi alienda wapi?

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.cause: The child remembers a place named near the question.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.reveals: A where-or-what question with another detail of the play.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.help: Find the line where it is said.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.feedback: Rudi kwenye igizo na utafute mstari unaotaja jibu.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.error: Gives the wrong meaning of a word in the play.

example.question: Neno "kuandamana" lina maana gani katika igizo?

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.cause: The child guesses from the look of the word.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.reveals: A meaning question for a word in the play.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.help: Read the line where the word is used and think who goes with whom.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.feedback: Maana ya neno hutokana na mstari lilimotumika katika igizo. Soma mstari huo tena.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Writes facts or an explanation where a story of events is asked.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni mwanzo wa insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Ndege Aliyenaswa"?
example.wrong_answer: Tai ni ndege mkubwa anayekula wanyama wadogo.
example.correct_answer: Tulimwona tai amenaswa kwenye wavu wa mkulima.

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: The child knows a lot about the topic and writes what he knows instead of telling what happened.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ni mwanzo wa insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Ndege Aliyenaswa"?" with "Tai ni ndege mkubwa anayekula wanyama wadogo." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Ask: who, where, what happened first, then, in the end? A story answers these; an explanation does not.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Masimulizi husimulia matukio yaliyotokea: nani, wapi, nini kilitokea.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Tells a past story in the present tense (-na-), or mixes -na- and -li- in one story.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika masimulizi ya jambo lililotokea jana: "Ndege Aliyenaswa"?
example.wrong_answer: Tunamwona tai amenaswa kwenye wavu wa mkulima.
example.correct_answer: Tulimwona tai amenaswa kwenye wavu wa mkulima.

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: The child writes as he speaks while remembering, and English stories in class are told in the present too.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika masimulizi ya jambo lililotokea jana: "Ndege Aliyenaswa"?" with "Tunamwona tai amenaswa kwenye wavu wa mkulima." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Circle every verb; check its tense marker against the time words (jana, siku moja).
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Jambo lililotokea husimuliwa kwa wakati uliopita: -li-.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Puts the events in an order that cannot have happened (the end before the start), with no linking words.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Ndege Aliyenaswa"?
example.wrong_answer: tai aliruka, tulikata wavu, tulimwita mlinzi, tulimwona tai
example.correct_answer: tulimwona tai, tulimwita mlinzi, tulikata wavu, tai aliruka

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: The child writes events as they come to mind; nobody has asked for a plan first.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Ndege Aliyenaswa"?" with "tai aliruka, tulikata wavu, tulimwita mlinzi, tulimwona tai" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Plan with three boxes (mwanzo, kati, mwisho) and linking words (kwanza, kisha, hatimaye) before writing.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Panga matukio yanavyofuatana, na utumie maneno kama kwanza, kisha na hatimaye.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Ends the insha abruptly ("Mwisho." or "The end") with no closing paragraph (hitimisho).

example.question: Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Ndege Aliyenaswa"?
example.correct_answer: Tangu siku hiyo, nimejifunza kuwa mwangalifu kila wakati.

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: Storybooks for young readers end with "Mwisho" and the child copies that.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Ndege Aliyenaswa"?" with "Mwisho." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Show three endings; the child picks the one that closes the main idea or the lesson.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Hitimisho hufunga insha kwa kueleza funzo au hisia, si kwa neno "Mwisho" tu.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.error: Writes the title as a full sentence with a full stop, or leaves it out.

example.question: Ni anwani ipi imeandikwa ipasavyo?

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.cause: The child treats the title as the first sentence of the insha.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.reveals: The question "Ni anwani ipi imeandikwa ipasavyo?" with "ndege aliyenaswa." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.help: Show where the title sits and how it is written (herufi kubwa, no kikomo, often underlined).
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.feedback: Anwani huandikwa juu katikati, bila kikomo, kwa herufi kubwa.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T8_INSHA_ZA_MASIMULIZI.IN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.error: Mixes kutendeka (can be done, becomes done) with kutendewa (done for someone).

example.question: Kikombe kilianguka na ___.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.cause: The endings -ika and -ewa both change the verb and look alike.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.reveals: Verb forms that differ in meaning: done for someone, can be done.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.help: Ask: is someone helped, or can the thing simply be done?
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.feedback: Kutendeka huonyesha kitu kinaweza kutendwa au kinatendeka chenyewe, kama kuvunjika. Kutendewa huonyesha kitendo kimefanyiwa mtu, kama kupikiwa.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.error: Leaves the verb in its base form where each does it to the other (wanasalimu for wanasalimiana).

example.question: Marafiki wawili ___ kila asubuhi.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.cause: The child keeps the base verb and does not show that each does it to the other.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.reveals: A gap that needs "to each other".
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.help: Ask whether they do it to each other.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.feedback: Kutendana huonyesha watu wawili au zaidi wanafanyiana kitendo kimoja: kusalimiana, kupendana, kusaidiana.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.error: Leaves the verb unchanged (soma) where an ending is needed (somewa, someka).

example.question: Mama alimpikia mtoto uji. Mtoto ___ uji na mama.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.cause: The child does not hear the change in meaning an ending brings.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.reveals: A gap that needs a changed verb.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.help: Ask whom the action is done for or by.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.feedback: Hapa kitenzi lazima kibadilike kwa kiambishi ili kuonyesha kinachotokea: mama alipikiwa chakula.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.error: Forms kutendeka with -ika where -eka is needed, or the reverse (someka/somika, chezeka/chezika).

example.question: Kauli ya kutendeka ya "soma" ni ipi?

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.cause: The vowel of the ending follows the vowel of the stem (e/o take -eka; a/i/u take -ika), which the child has not been shown.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.reveals: The question "Kauli ya kutendeka ya "soma" ni ipi?" with "somika" among the options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.help: Sort stems by their last vowel: soma, cheza, ona -> -eka; pika, funga, kata -> -ika.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.feedback: Kitenzi chenye o au e kwenye mzizi huchukua -eka: someka.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.L.error: Takes an informal setting (playing at home, a chat with a cousin) for an official one, or the reverse.

example.question: Ni muktadha upi ni rasmi?
example.correct_answer: kumweleza daktari dalili za ugonjwa kliniki

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.L.cause: The child judges by who is there (a grown-up) and not by the purpose and place.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.L.reveals: The question "Ni muktadha upi ni rasmi?" with "kuzungumza na binamu nyumbani" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.L.help: Sort setting cards by place and purpose: is there an office, a duty, a record?
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.L.feedback: Muktadha rasmi una kazi maalum na mahali rasmi: kliniki, ofisi, mkutano.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.L.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.L.error: Uses Sheng or slang to an official (Daktari, niko poa tu, ni homa kiasi).

example.question: Daktari anakuuliza unajisikiaje. Unajibu vipi?
example.wrong_answer: Niko poa tu daktari, ni ka-homa.
example.correct_answer: Ninaumwa na kichwa na nina homa tangu jana, daktari.

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.L.cause: The child speaks to everyone in the language of friends.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.L.reveals: The question "Daktari anakuuliza unajisikiaje. Unajibu vipi?" with "Niko poa tu daktari, ni ka-homa." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.L.help: Record one answer in Sheng and one in standard Kiswahili; which helps the doctor more?
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.L.feedback: Kwa daktari tunaeleza wazi kwa Kiswahili sanifu.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.L.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.L.error: Addresses an official by first name or with no title (Hello Wanjiku! to the head teacher).

example.question: Unaingia ofisini kwa Mwalimu Mkuu. Unasema?

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.L.cause: At home and with friends names are used; the child has not been taught titles.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.L.reveals: The question "Unaingia ofisini kwa Mwalimu Mkuu. Unasema?" with "Habari Wanjiku!" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.L.help: List titles: Mwalimu Mkuu, Daktari, Chifu, Mheshimiwa; use them in every role play.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.L.feedback: Katika muktadha rasmi tunatumia cheo: Mwalimu Mkuu, Daktari.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.L.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.L.error: Interrupts an official or speaks out of turn in a meeting.

example.question: Katika mkutano wa shule, unataka kuuliza swali. Ufanye nini?
example.wrong_answer: uliza mara moja hata kama mwenzako anazungumza
example.correct_answer: inua mkono na usubiri kupewa nafasi

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.L.cause: Turn-taking rules of class are not linked to other official settings.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.L.reveals: The question "Katika mkutano wa shule, unataka kuuliza swali. Ufanye nini?" with "uliza mara moja hata kama mwenzako anazungumza" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.L.help: Run a mock meeting with a chair; only the person given the floor speaks.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.L.feedback: Katika mkutano rasmi, omba nafasi kabla ya kuzungumza.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.L.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Chooses a book by its cover picture or its thickness only.

example.question: Unataka kusoma kuhusu magonjwa. Utachaguaje kitabu?
example.correct_answer: kwa kusoma anwani, maelezo ya nyuma na ukurasa wa kwanza

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: Nobody has shown the child the title, the blurb and the first page as clues.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Unataka kusoma kuhusu magonjwa. Utachaguaje kitabu?" with "kwa picha nzuri ya jalada" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: Hold up two books; read the title and the back of each aloud; the child chooses and says which clue decided it.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Anwani, maelezo ya nyuma ya kitabu na ukurasa wa kwanza hukuambia kitabu kinahusu nini.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Chooses a text far above his reading level and gives up after a page.

example.question: Ukisoma ukurasa wa kwanza wa "Malaria Haina Nafasi Kwetu" na hujui maneno mengi sana, ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: chagua matini nyingine iliyo ya kiwango chako

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: The child thinks a harder book is a better book, or chooses the book a friend chose.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Ukisoma ukurasa wa kwanza wa "Malaria Haina Nafasi Kwetu" na hujui maneno mengi sana, ufanye nini?" with "endelea tu hata kama huelewi" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: The five-finger check: on one page, a finger for each unknown word; five fingers means the book is too hard for now.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Matini ifaayo ni ile unayoweza kuisoma na kuielewa ukiwa peke yako.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Gives the title as the message of the text.

example.question: Ujumbe wa matini "Malaria Haina Nafasi Kwetu" ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Tukilala ndani ya chandarua na kufukia madimbwi, tunajikinga na malaria.

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: The title is the only sentence about the whole text that the child is sure of.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa matini "Malaria Haina Nafasi Kwetu" ni upi?" with "Malaria Haina Nafasi Kwetu" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: Ask what the writer wants the reader to learn or do; the title only names the topic.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Anwani hutaja mada; ujumbe ni funzo au wazo kuu ambalo mwandishi anataka ulipate.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Gives one detail of the text as its message.

example.question: Ni ipi ni ujumbe wa matini kuhusu magonjwa?
example.correct_answer: Tukilala ndani ya chandarua na kufukia madimbwi, tunajikinga na malaria.

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: The detail was striking and is remembered; the child has not asked what the whole text is about.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni ujumbe wa matini kuhusu magonjwa?" with "Mama alinunua chandarua kipya sokoni." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: Two boxes: "ujumbe" (one) and "maelezo" (many); the child sorts sentences from the text.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Ujumbe unahusu matini yote; jambo moja dogo ni maelezo tu.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Does not tell one kind of text from another (takes a newspaper report for a story, or a poem for a story).

example.question: Matini yenye beti na mishororo ni ya aina gani?

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: The child has met most texts as "kitabu" and has not been shown the signs of each kind.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Matini yenye beti na mishororo ni ya aina gani?" with "hadithi" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: Lay out a story, a poem, a newspaper page and a dictionary; the child names one sign of each.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Shairi lina beti na mishororo; hadithi ina aya; gazeti lina habari na tarehe.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.error: Guesses a new word from how it looks, not from the sentence it is in (dalili).

example.question: Katika matini: "Homa na kutetemeka ni dalili za malaria." Neno "dalili" lina maana gani?

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.cause: The child matches the word to a word it looks like instead of reading the sentence around it.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.reveals: The question "Katika matini: "Homa na kutetemeka ni dalili za malaria." Neno "dalili" lina maana gani?" with "dawa ya ugonjwa" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.help: Cover the word; the child reads the sentence and says what word would fit; then compares.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.feedback: Soma sentensi nzima: "dalili" hapa ni ishara zinazoonyesha ugonjwa.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.MATI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Tells a story of what happened where the insha should explain or describe.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Malaria"?
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, lala ndani ya chandarua kilichotiwa dawa kila usiku.

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: Stories are the kind of writing the child has done most and he falls back on it.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Malaria"?" with "Siku moja tulienda sokoni tukapotea." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Ask what the reader should know about the topic at the end: what it is, how it works or is done.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Insha ya maelezo hueleza jambo lilivyo au jinsi linavyofanywa, si matukio ya siku moja.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Describes with empty words (kizuri sana, kibaya) and no detail that makes a picture.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Malaria"?
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, lala ndani ya chandarua kilichotiwa dawa kila usiku.

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child knows the thing well and assumes the reader sees it too.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Malaria"?" with "Malaria ni ugonjwa mbaya." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Five senses chart: what do you see, hear, smell, touch, taste? Turn one row into a sentence.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Gives the steps of how to do something in a mixed-up order.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Malaria"?
example.wrong_answer: nenda kliniki ukiugua, lala ndani ya chandarua, fukia madimbwi, fyeka nyasi
example.correct_answer: fyeka nyasi, fukia madimbwi, lala ndani ya chandarua, nenda kliniki ukiugua

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child remembers the steps as a set, not as a sequence.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Malaria"?" with "nenda kliniki ukiugua, lala ndani ya chandarua, fukia madimbwi, fyeka nyasi" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Act out the steps; number them; write them with kwanza, kisha, mwishowe.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Maelezo ya jinsi ya kufanya jambo hufuata hatua kwa mpangilio.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Malaria", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, lala ndani ya chandarua kilichotiwa dawa kila usiku.

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Malaria", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.error: Writes the whole insha as one paragraph with no utangulizi, kiini and hitimisho.

example.question: Insha "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Malaria" ina sehemu zipi?

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.cause: The child writes until the space is full and has not planned the parts.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.reveals: The question "Insha "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Malaria" ina sehemu zipi?" with "aya moja ndefu" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.help: Fold the page into three; one part in each; one idea per paragraph in the middle.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.feedback: Insha ina utangulizi, kiini chenye aya kadhaa, na hitimisho.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T9_INSHA_YA_MAELEZO.INSHA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VITENZI.VI.error: Makes the opposite of a verb by adding si or ha (sifunga) instead of the opposite verb.

example.question: Kinyume cha "kufunga" ni ___.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VITENZI.VI.cause: The child takes "not doing it" to be the opposite.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VITENZI.VI.reveals: An opposite question with a negative form as one option.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VITENZI.VI.help: Is there one word that means the reverse action?
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VITENZI.VI.feedback: Kinyume cha kitenzi ni kitenzi kingine chenye maana ya kutengua kitendo, kama kufunga - kufungua. Si "kutofunga".
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VITENZI.VI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VITENZI.VI.error: Forms the opposite by adding -ua or -ulia to every verb (kuvaa to kuvaua).

example.question: Kinyume cha "kuvaa" ni ___.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VITENZI.VI.cause: The child copies kufunga - kufungua for every verb.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VITENZI.VI.reveals: An opposite where the pattern -ua does not work.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VITENZI.VI.help: Say the word aloud: does it exist?
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VITENZI.VI.feedback: Vitenzi vingine vinabadilika kwa njia tofauti. Kinyume cha kuvaa ni kuvua.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VITENZI.VI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VITENZI.VI.error: Gives a word of similar meaning instead of the opposite.

example.question: Kinyume cha "kuingia" ni ___.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VITENZI.VI.cause: The child keeps the same idea and does not reverse it.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VITENZI.VI.reveals: An opposite question with a synonym as one option.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VITENZI.VI.help: Does the word mean the same, or the other way round?
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VITENZI.VI.feedback: Kinyume kina maana ya upande wa pili. Kuingia na kutoka ni vinyume.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VITENZI.VI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VITENZI.VI.error: Reverses a verb with -ua where the opposite is a different word (kuja -> kujua for kwenda; kupanda -> kupandua for kushuka).

example.question: Kinyume cha "panda (mlima)" ni?

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VITENZI.VI.cause: Funga/fungua and vaa/vua teach -ua as the rule for every verb.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VITENZI.VI.reveals: The question "Kinyume cha "panda (mlima)" ni?" with "pandua" among the options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VITENZI.VI.help: Sort verbs: those reversed with -ua (funga/fungua, vaa/vua) and those with another word (panda/shuka, ingia/toka).
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VITENZI.VI.feedback: Kinyume cha panda (mlima) ni shuka; si kila kitenzi hutumia -ua.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_VITENZI.VI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M_T.error: Gives the wrong animal or thing in the simile (mkali kama sungura).

example.question: Baba yetu ni mkali kama ___.

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M_T.cause: The child knows the idea but not the usual comparison.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M_T.reveals: A simile with plausible animals as options.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M_T.help: Which animal do we say is fierce?
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M_T.feedback: Tashbihi hutumia ulinganisho wa kawaida: mkali kama simba, mwoga kama sungura, mpole kama kondoo.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M_T.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M_T.error: Leaves out kama or "mithili ya", and says "Yeye ni simba" as a simile.

example.question: Ni tashbihi ipi?

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M_T.cause: The child mixes a simile with a metaphor.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M_T.reveals: A simile and a metaphor as options.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M_T.help: A simile has the word kama or mithili ya.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M_T.feedback: Tashbihi hulinganisha kwa kutumia kama au mithili ya: mkali kama simba. Kusema "yeye ni simba" ni sitiari.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M_T.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M_T.error: Takes the simile word for word (the person is really a lion).

example.question: "Juma ni mwoga kama sungura" maana yake nini?

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M_T.cause: The child does not read the comparison as a way to describe behaviour.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M_T.reveals: A meaning question for a simile.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M_T.help: Ask what behaviour the animal stands for.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M_T.feedback: Tashbihi inaelezea tabia kwa kulinganisha. "Mwoga kama sungura" ina maana mtu ana hofu sana.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M_T.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M5_.error: Uses a simile for the opposite character (mwaminifu kama fisi).

example.question: Kamilisha: mjanja kama ___

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M5_.cause: The child knows the animals of the folk tales but mixes which stands for what.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M5_.reveals: The question "Kamilisha: mjanja kama ___" with "kondoo" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M5_.help: Recall the folk tales: Sungura is clever, Fisi is greedy, Kondoo is gentle; build the chart together.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M5_.feedback: Sungura ni mjanja katika hadithi, kwa hiyo mjanja kama sungura.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.M5_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..error: Mixes up a folder and a file: looks for the passage on the screen without opening the folder it is in.

example.question: Kifungu "Itikadi Potovu" kimehifadhiwa ndani ya folda "Kiswahili". Utakifunguaje?
example.wrong_answer: bonyeza "Itikadi Potovu" kwenye skrini ya mwanzo
example.correct_answer: fungua folda "Kiswahili", kisha bonyeza mara mbili faili "Itikadi Potovu"

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..cause: The child has only used apps on a phone, where there are no folders.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..reveals: The question "Kifungu "Itikadi Potovu" kimehifadhiwa ndani ya folda "Kiswahili". Utakifunguaje?" with "bonyeza "Itikadi Potovu" kwenye skrini ya mwanzo" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..help: Show a real folder (a box file) holding papers; then the same on the screen.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..feedback: Faili huhifadhiwa ndani ya folda; fungua folda kwanza, kisha faili.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..error: Types a whole long question, with spelling mistakes, into the search box.

example.question: Unatafuta habari kuhusu itikadi za kidini na za kijamii. Utaandika nini kwenye kisanduku cha kutafutia?
example.wrong_answer: naomba unipe habari zote kuhusu itikadi za kidini na za kijamii tafadhali

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..cause: The child talks to the search box as to a person.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..reveals: The question "Unatafuta habari kuhusu itikadi za kidini na za kijamii. Utaandika nini kwenye kisanduku cha kutafutia?" with "naomba unipe habari zote kuhusu itikadi za kidini na za kijamii tafadhali" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..help: Underline the two or three words that carry the meaning; search with those; compare the results.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..feedback: Andika maneno mawili au matatu muhimu tu, na uyaandike kwa tahajia sahihi.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..error: Clicks a pop-up or an advert that says he has won a prize.

example.question: Ukiwa unasoma, ujumbe unatokea: "Umeshinda simu! Bonyeza hapa." Ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: usibonyeze; funga ujumbe na umwambie mwalimu au mzazi

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..cause: Offers of prizes are exciting and the child does not know they are traps.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..reveals: The question "Ukiwa unasoma, ujumbe unatokea: "Umeshinda simu! Bonyeza hapa." Ufanye nini?" with "bonyeza ili kupokea simu" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..help: Show two screenshots, one real page and one trap; the child finds three signs of the trap.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..feedback: Ujumbe wa zawadi usiotarajiwa ni mtego; usiubonyeze.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..error: Uses any site that comes up and gives his name, school or phone number when a site asks.

example.question: Tovuti inakuuliza jina lako kamili, shule yako na nambari ya simu ya mzazi kabla ya kusoma hadithi. Ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: usijaze; tumia tovuti salama aliyokupa mwalimu

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..cause: The child wants the story and does not see personal details as worth protecting.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..reveals: The question "Tovuti inakuuliza jina lako kamili, shule yako na nambari ya simu ya mzazi kabla ya kusoma hadithi. Ufanye nini?" with "jaza ili usome hadithi" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..help: List the details that are private; practise saying no to a form.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..feedback: Usimpe mtu yeyote mtandaoni jina lako kamili, shule yako wala nambari ya simu.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..error: Puts the steps of finding and reading a passage in the wrong order (reads before searching, or searches before switching on).

example.question: Ni hatua ipi huja kwanza?

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..cause: The child has watched an adult do the steps quickly and remembers the parts, not the order.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..reveals: The question "Ni hatua ipi huja kwanza?" with "andika maneno ya kutafutia" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..help: Step cards: the child orders them, then does them on a real device.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..feedback: Washa kifaa, fungua kivinjari, andika maneno muhimu, chagua tovuti salama, soma.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T10_MATINI_YA_KIDIJITALI..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.error: Writes facts or an explanation where a story of events is asked.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni mwanzo wa insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Siku Bibi Alipoacha Imani Potovu"?
example.wrong_answer: Imani potovu ni mawazo yasiyo ya kweli.
example.correct_answer: Bibi aliamini kuwa paka mweusi huleta mkosi.

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.cause: The child knows a lot about the topic and writes what he knows instead of telling what happened.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ni mwanzo wa insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Siku Bibi Alipoacha Imani Potovu"?" with "Imani potovu ni mawazo yasiyo ya kweli." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.help: Ask: who, where, what happened first, then, in the end? A story answers these; an explanation does not.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.feedback: Masimulizi husimulia matukio yaliyotokea: nani, wapi, nini kilitokea.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.error: Tells a past story in the present tense (-na-), or mixes -na- and -li- in one story.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika masimulizi ya jambo lililotokea jana: "Siku Bibi Alipoacha Imani Potovu"?
example.wrong_answer: Bibi anaamini kuwa paka mweusi huleta mkosi.
example.correct_answer: Bibi aliamini kuwa paka mweusi huleta mkosi.

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.cause: The child writes as he speaks while remembering, and English stories in class are told in the present too.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika masimulizi ya jambo lililotokea jana: "Siku Bibi Alipoacha Imani Potovu"?" with "Bibi anaamini kuwa paka mweusi huleta mkosi." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.help: Circle every verb; check its tense marker against the time words (jana, siku moja).
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.feedback: Jambo lililotokea husimuliwa kwa wakati uliopita: -li-.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.error: Puts the events in an order that cannot have happened (the end before the start), with no linking words.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Siku Bibi Alipoacha Imani Potovu"?
example.wrong_answer: bibi alimfuga paka, bibi alielewa, mwalimu alieleza ukweli, bibi aliogopa paka
example.correct_answer: bibi aliogopa paka, mwalimu alieleza ukweli, bibi alielewa, bibi alimfuga paka

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.cause: The child writes events as they come to mind; nobody has asked for a plan first.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Siku Bibi Alipoacha Imani Potovu"?" with "bibi alimfuga paka, bibi alielewa, mwalimu alieleza ukweli, bibi aliogopa paka" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.help: Plan with three boxes (mwanzo, kati, mwisho) and linking words (kwanza, kisha, hatimaye) before writing.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.feedback: Panga matukio yanavyofuatana, na utumie maneno kama kwanza, kisha na hatimaye.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.error: Ends the insha abruptly ("Mwisho." or "The end") with no closing paragraph (hitimisho).

example.question: Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Siku Bibi Alipoacha Imani Potovu"?
example.correct_answer: Tangu siku hiyo, nimejifunza kuwa mwangalifu kila wakati.

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.cause: Storybooks for young readers end with "Mwisho" and the child copies that.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Siku Bibi Alipoacha Imani Potovu"?" with "Mwisho." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.help: Show three endings; the child picks the one that closes the main idea or the lesson.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.feedback: Hitimisho hufunga insha kwa kueleza funzo au hisia, si kwa neno "Mwisho" tu.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.error: Puts English or Sheng words in the insha (tulienda kwa party, mathe, form).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi imeandikwa kwa Kiswahili sanifu?

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.cause: The child speaks a mixed language at home and with friends and does not notice the switch in writing.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi imeandikwa kwa Kiswahili sanifu?" with "Mathe alinipea form ya kujaza." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.help: Underline each non-Kiswahili word; find the Kiswahili word together (mama, sherehe, fomu).
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.feedback: Insha huandikwa kwa Kiswahili sanifu, bila maneno ya Kiingereza wala Sheng.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T10_INSHA_YA_MASIMULIZI.I.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.MAZOE.error: Adds a subject prefix to hu- (anahunywa, huanasoma).

example.question: Kila asubuhi Juma ___ maji.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.MAZOE.cause: The child thinks every verb must have a person prefix.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.MAZOE.reveals: A gap for hali ya mazoea with prefixed forms.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.MAZOE.help: Say "Juma hunywa maji" aloud: does hu- already stand for the person?
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.MAZOE.feedback: Katika hali ya mazoea, hu- hubeba wakati na hakuna kiambishi cha mtu: Juma hunywa maji.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.MAZOE.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.MAZOE.error: Uses -li- (past) where the action is complete and is still true now (-me-).

example.question: Mama ___ kupika chakula (sasa kiko tayari).

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.MAZOE.cause: The child treats -me- and -li- as the same: both mean "past".
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.MAZOE.reveals: A gap where the action is finished but still matters now.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.MAZOE.help: Ask whether the action is finished now, with a result you can see.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.MAZOE.feedback: -me- huonyesha kitendo kimekamilika na matokeo yake yapo sasa. -li- huonyesha kitendo cha zamani kilichopita.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.MAZOE.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.MAZOE.error: Uses -na- (now) for what is done every day.

example.question: Kila Jumamosi Wanjiru ___ nguo.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.MAZOE.cause: The child thinks every action that happens "now" is -na-.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.MAZOE.reveals: A gap for something done every week.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.MAZOE.help: Does it happen every time, or only now?
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.MAZOE.feedback: Kitendo kinachofanyika kila mara huandikwa kwa hu-: Wanjiru hufua nguo.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.MAZOE.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.MAZOE.error: Uses -me- for something that has not happened yet (kesho nimemaliza).

example.question: Jaza: Kesho saa nne ___ (maliza) kazi.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.MAZOE.cause: -me- is felt as "done" and the child uses it for any finished action, even in the future.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.MAZOE.reveals: The question "Jaza: Kesho saa nne ___ (maliza) kazi." with "nimemaliza" among the options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.MAZOE.help: Timeline: -me- is finished by now; for "finished by a future time" Kiswahili uses nitakuwa nimemaliza.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.MAZOE.feedback: -me- huonyesha jambo limekamilika sasa; kwa wakati ujao tunasema nitakuwa nimemaliza.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.MAZOE.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.error: Gives a detail of the narration as its message.

example.question: Ulisikiliza masimulizi kuhusu kijana aliyeweka akiba kununua mbuzi. Ujumbe wake ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Tukiweka akiba na kuwekeza kwa busara, tunajenga maisha bora.

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.cause: The detail was vivid; the child has not asked what the whole narration teaches.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.reveals: The question "Ulisikiliza masimulizi kuhusu kijana aliyeweka akiba kununua mbuzi. Ujumbe wake ni upi?" with "Kijana alinunua mbuzi wawili." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.help: After listening, ask: what did the speaker want us to learn? Then: what is one thing that happened?
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.feedback: Ujumbe ni funzo la masimulizi yote; jambo moja ni maelezo tu.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.error: Retells the events in a mixed order, starting with the most exciting part.

example.question: Unaposimulia, unaanza na nini?

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.cause: The child jumps to the part that impressed him most.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.reveals: The question "Unaposimulia, unaanza na nini?" with "sehemu ya kusisimua zaidi" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.help: Retell with three fingers: mwanzo, kati, mwisho.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.feedback: Simulia kwa mpangilio: mwanzo, kati, mwisho.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.error: Uses gestures or a face that do not match the words (smiles while telling a sad part, stands still for an action).

example.question: Unasimulia: "Mbuzi wake walizaana wakawa wengi sana!" Ishara ipi inafaa?

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.cause: The child is nervous and does not link the body to the words.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.reveals: The question "Unasimulia: "Mbuzi wake walizaana wakawa wengi sana!" Ishara ipi inafaa?" with "kushika kichwa kwa huzuni" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.help: Mirror game in pairs: one says a line, the other shows the feeling; swap.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.feedback: Ishara na sura yako ziendane na unachosema.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.error: Mixes English or Sheng into the telling (Then tukaenda..., ilikuwa poa sana).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa unaposimulia darasani?
example.wrong_answer: Then tukaenda home, ilikuwa poa sana.
example.correct_answer: Kisha tukaenda nyumbani; ilikuwa siku nzuri sana.

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.cause: The child narrates as he talks with friends.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa unaposimulia darasani?" with "Then tukaenda home, ilikuwa poa sana." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.help: Record a telling; play it back; the child finds the non-Kiswahili words and replaces them.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.feedback: Simulia kwa Kiswahili sanifu: kisha, nyumbani, nzuri.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.error: Tells a story that is not on the topic given (uwekezaji (investment)).

example.question: Mada ni uwekezaji (investment). Ni masimulizi yapi yanafaa?
example.correct_answer: Siku kijana aliyeweka akiba kununua mbuzi

KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.cause: The child tells the story he knows best, whatever the topic.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.reveals: The question "Mada ni uwekezaji (investment). Ni masimulizi yapi yanafaa?" with "Siku nilipotazama mechi ya mpira" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.help: Write the topic on the board; before telling, the child says in one sentence how his story fits it.
KISW.G5.KUSIKI.T11_MASIMULIZI.MASIMULIZI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Wanakijiji walianzisha chama cha kuweka akiba na kukopa."?
example.wrong_answer: Wanakijiji ... walianzisha ... chama ... cha ... kuweka ... akiba ... na ... kukopa.
example.correct_answer: Wanakijiji walianzisha chama cha kuweka akiba na kukopa.

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: The child is still decoding each word and has not yet learnt to read a phrase as one piece.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Wanakijiji walianzisha chama cha kuweka akiba na kukopa."?" with "Wanakijiji ... walianzisha ... chama ... cha ... kuweka ... akiba ... na ... kukopa." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it as one breath; then phrase-cut the passage with slashes.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.feedback: Usomaji wa ufasaha husoma kundi la maneno kwa pamoja, kama tunavyozungumza.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, ili kila neno lisikike

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; the child has not been asked whether listeners understood.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Time two readings: one very fast, one at speaking pace; listeners answer one question after each.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ile ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Reads a question and an exclamation in the same flat voice as a statement.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, unajua faida ya kuweka akiba?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the mark at the end.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, unajua faida ya kuweka akiba?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that matches each reading.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; alama ya hisi (!) huonyesha hisia.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Reads on through the koma and the kikomo without a pause.

example.question: Unasoma: "Ajabu, biashara yake imestawi sana!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?
example.wrong_answer: hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja
example.correct_answer: kwenye koma na kwenye kikomo au alama ya hisi

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: The marks are read as decoration; the child has not linked them to breath.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Unasoma: "Ajabu, biashara yake imestawi sana!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?" with "hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Clap once at a koma, twice at a kikomo while reading together.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.feedback: Simama kidogo kwenye koma, na zaidi kwenye kikomo.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Says /l/ for /r/ or /r/ for /l/ while reading (faida read as faita).

example.question: Neno "faida" linatamkwa vipi?

KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: The first language of the child does not separate these sounds, so the reading carries the home sound.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Neno "faida" linatamkwa vipi?" with "faita" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Make a list of the passage words with the hard sound; practise them before reading the passage.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.feedback: Tamka "faida" kama lilivyoandikwa; "faita" ni neno jingine au si neno.
KISW.G5.KUSOMA.T11_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T11_BARUAPEPE.KUANDIKA_BA.error: Leaves the subject box empty or writes the whole message in it.

example.question: Katika baruapepe, kisanduku cha "Kichwa" kinaandikwa nini?
example.correct_answer: maneno machache yanayotaja ujumbe, kama "Mpango wa Kuweka Akiba"

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T11_BARUAPEPE.KUANDIKA_BA.cause: The child has used chat apps that have no subject line.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T11_BARUAPEPE.KUANDIKA_BA.reveals: The question "Katika baruapepe, kisanduku cha "Kichwa" kinaandikwa nini?" with "ujumbe wote" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T11_BARUAPEPE.KUANDIKA_BA.help: Show an inbox: the subject is all the reader sees before opening.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T11_BARUAPEPE.KUANDIKA_BA.feedback: Kichwa cha baruapepe ni maneno machache yanayoeleza ujumbe unahusu nini.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T11_BARUAPEPE.KUANDIKA_BA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T11_BARUAPEPE.KUANDIKA_BA.error: Writes a postal address and a date at the top, as in a paper letter.

example.question: Baruapepe huanza vipi?
example.wrong_answer: S.L.P. 120, Nakuru, na tarehe juu kulia

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T11_BARUAPEPE.KUANDIKA_BA.cause: The paper letter is the model the child knows.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T11_BARUAPEPE.KUANDIKA_BA.reveals: The question "Baruapepe huanza vipi?" with "S.L.P. 120, Nakuru, na tarehe juu kulia" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T11_BARUAPEPE.KUANDIKA_BA.help: Compare a paper letter and an email; the email programme adds the address and date.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T11_BARUAPEPE.KUANDIKA_BA.feedback: Baruapepe haina anwani ya posta wala tarehe juu; kifaa huziweka chenyewe.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T11_BARUAPEPE.KUANDIKA_BA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T11_BARUAPEPE.KUANDIKA_BA.error: Puts the receiver's name, not the email address, in the "Kwa" box.

example.question: Kisanduku cha "Kwa" kinaandikwa nini?

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T11_BARUAPEPE.KUANDIKA_BA.cause: The child writes the person as on an envelope.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T11_BARUAPEPE.KUANDIKA_BA.reveals: The question "Kisanduku cha "Kwa" kinaandikwa nini?" with "Amina Otieno" among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T11_BARUAPEPE.KUANDIKA_BA.help: Show what an email address looks like (jina@mahali); practise reading it aloud.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T11_BARUAPEPE.KUANDIKA_BA.feedback: Kisanduku cha "Kwa" huandikwa anwani ya baruapepe ya mpokeaji, yenye @.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T11_BARUAPEPE.KUANDIKA_BA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher
