KISW.G5.KUANDI.T11_BARUAPEPE.KUANDIKA_BA.error: Writes in short chat forms (sawa, poa, nkt, 2moro) and no closing.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika baruapepe?

KISW.G5.KUANDI.T11_BARUAPEPE.KUANDIKA_BA.cause: Chat habits come into the email.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T11_BARUAPEPE.KUANDIKA_BA.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika baruapepe?" with "Poa, tutaonana 2moro." among the options.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T11_BARUAPEPE.KUANDIKA_BA.help: Rewrite one chat message as a short email with a greeting and a closing.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T11_BARUAPEPE.KUANDIKA_BA.feedback: Baruapepe huandikwa kwa lugha sahihi, na humalizika kwa hitimisho na jina.
KISW.G5.KUANDI.T11_BARUAPEPE.KUANDIKA_BA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.error: Makes the negative by putting si or hapana before the verb (si nasoma).

example.question: Kanusha: "Ninasoma kitabu."

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.cause: The child copies English "I do not" or puts a word in front.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.reveals: A negative with si before the verb.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.help: Ask whether the verb itself changes its beginning.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.feedback: Kitenzi kinakanushwa kwa kubadili kiambishi cha mtu na wakati ndani yake, si kwa kuweka "si" mbele. Ninasoma - sisomi.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.error: Keeps the tense marker (-na-, -me-, -li-) in the negative (hamesoma instead of hajasoma).

example.question: Kanusha: "Amesoma kitabu."

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.cause: The child takes only the person prefix and keeps the rest.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.reveals: A negative in -me- written as hame-.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.help: Ask which letters replace -me- in the negative.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.feedback: Katika ukanusho, -me- hubadilika kuwa -ja-: amesoma - hajasoma. -li- hubadilika kuwa -ku-: alisoma - hakusoma.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.error: Keeps the positive person prefix (ni-, tu-, wa-) in the negative.

example.question: Kanusha: "Tutasoma kesho."

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.cause: The child changes the tense but not the person prefix.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.reveals: A negative of tu- written as tu- plus si.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.help: Ask what the negative of ninasoma starts with (si-), and of tutasoma (hatu-).
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.feedback: Viambishi vya nafsi hubadilika katika ukanusho: ni- - si-, u- - hu-, a- - ha-, tu- - hatu-, m- - ham-, wa- - hawa-.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.error: Keeps -na- in the negative present (hasomina, hanasoma).

example.question: Kanusha: "Anasoma kitabu."

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.cause: The child drops -na- but not entirely; present negative has no tense marker.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.help: Say the negative aloud: does it have -na-?
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.feedback: Wakati uliopo hukanushwa bila -na-, na kitenzi humalizika kwa -i: anasoma - hasomi.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.error: Gives the negative of another tense (hasomi for hajasoma, sikusoma for sisomi).

example.question: Kanusha: "Amesoma kitabu."

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.cause: The child makes a correct negative but of the wrong tense.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.reveals: A negative of a different tense among the options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.help: Ask which tense the positive sentence is in, and which negative marks it.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.feedback: Ukanusho wa kila wakati una kiambishi chake: -na- hukanushwa bila kiambishi (hasomi), -me- huwa -ja- (hajasoma), -li- huwa -ku- (hakusoma), -ta- hubaki -ta- (hatasoma).
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..error: Swaps the big form (ji-) and the small form (ki-).

example.question: Udogo wa "mtoto" ni ___.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..cause: The child learned both prefixes but not which means big and which small.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..reveals: Questions that ask for big and for small.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..help: Ki- is the prefix of kijiji, kitoto, kijiko: small things.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..feedback: Ki- huonyesha udogo (kitoto, kijiji) na ji- huonyesha ukubwa (jitoto, jiji).
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..error: Keeps the m- (jimtoto, kimtoto) when the new prefix goes on.

example.question: Ukubwa wa "mtoto" ni ___.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..cause: The child adds the prefix to the whole word.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..reveals: A gap where m- is left on.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..help: Take away the m- of mtoto, then add ji-.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..feedback: M- ya mwanzo huondolewa kabla ya kuongeza kiambishi cha ukubwa au udogo: mtoto - jitoto, kitoto.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..error: Does not add ji- to a noun with one-syllable root (mti, mto, mji) when making the small form (kimti, kimto).

example.question: Udogo wa "mji" ni ___.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..cause: The child uses the rule for longer roots.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..reveals: Small forms of mji, mto, mti.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..help: Say the word kijiji aloud: where is the ji?
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..feedback: Nomino zenye shina la silabi moja zinaongeza ji- kabla ya ki-: mji - kijiji, mto - kijito, mti - kijiti.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..error: Gives the big or small form but keeps the agreement of the ordinary noun (jitoto analia for jitoto linalia).

example.question: Jaza: Kitoto ___ (kinalia / analia).

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..cause: The child changes the noun and keeps the person agreement.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..reveals: The question "Jaza: Kitoto ___ (kinalia / analia)." with "analia" among the options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..help: The big form takes LI-YA (jitoto linalia), the small form KI-VI (kitoto kinalia).
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..feedback: Udogo huchukua upatanisho wa KI-VI: kitoto kinalia.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N_.error: Keeps the n- or ny- of the noun (jinyumba, kinyumba).

example.question: Ukubwa wa "nyumba" ni ___.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N_.cause: The child does not drop the first sound as with m- nouns.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N_.reveals: A gap where the first sound is kept.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N_.feedback: Nomino za n- hubadilika kwa kuondoa sauti ya mwanzo: nyumba - jumba, kijumba. Baadhi huongeza ji- (mbwa - jibwa).
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N_.error: Swaps ji-/ju- (big) and ki- (small) for n- nouns.

example.question: Udogo wa "nyumba" ni ___.

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N_.cause: Two prefixes and two meanings, learned together.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N_.reveals: Big and small forms asked in turn.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N_.help: Ki- is small: kijumba is a hut.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N_.feedback: Ki- huonyesha udogo: kijumba. Ukubwa huonyeshwa na ji- au umbo la pekee kama jumba.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N_.error: Uses ji- where ju- is needed for an n- noun with a root starting with a vowel or after ny- (nyumba -> jumba).

example.question: Ukubwa wa "nyumba" ni?

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N_.cause: ji- is the big prefix learnt with m- nouns; the n-/ny- is kept.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N_.reveals: The question "Ukubwa wa "nyumba" ni?" with "jinyumba" among the options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N_.help: Drop n- or ny-, then add ji- (or ju- before -mba: jumba); compare with the dictionary.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N_.error: Keeps the I-ZI agreement for the big form (jumba imejengwa for jumba limejengwa).

example.question: Jaza: Jumba ___ (limejengwa / imejengwa).

KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N_.cause: The child changes the noun and keeps the I-ZI prefix of nyumba.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N_.reveals: The question "Jaza: Jumba ___ (limejengwa / imejengwa)." with "imejengwa" among the options.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N_.help: The big form moves to LI-YA: jumba li-, majumba ya-.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N_.feedback: Jumba ni la LI-YA: jumba limejengwa.
KISW.G5.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_NA_UDOGO_WA_N_.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher
